# North Carolina
## Initial conditions
```{r}
source("SMH_fitting_setup_NC.R")

#### initial conditions ####

init_NC <- rep(0,length(names_var_nolatino))
names(init_NC) <- names_var_nolatino
initial_I_NC <- df_NC %>%
  filter(day == 119)
initial_DR_NC <- cum_init_NC %>%
  filter(day == 119)
## RepCases and D are based on the reported infections/deaths on day 119, since both observed and model data are counted cumulatively from day 119. 
## R is calculated off of calibration_NC and the cumulative number of reported cases up to 119


init_NC["RepCases_asian"] <- 106
init_NC["D_asian"] <- 3
init_NC["R1_asian"] <- 285

init_NC["RepCases_black"] <- 559
init_NC["D_black"] <- 143
init_NC["R1_black"] <- 3570

init_NC["RepCases_other"] <- 428
init_NC["D_other"] <- 9
init_NC["R1_other"] <- 1346

init_NC["RepCases_white"] <- 1109
init_NC["D_white"] <- 270
init_NC["R1_white"] <- 5445
```

## Plot output of MLE
```{r}

run_start <- as.Date("5-1-2020", "%m-%d-%Y")

df_NC2 <- read_csv("../data/fit/target_data_phase2.csv") %>% 
  filter(location == 37) %>%
  mutate(calib_start = difftime(run_start, min(date), units = "days")) %>%
  mutate(day = difftime(date, min(date), units = "days")) %>% 
  mutate(day = gsub(" days", "", day), day = as.numeric(day)) %>% 
  mutate(observed = if_else(target == "inc death", value + min_suppressed, value)) %>% 
  group_by(day, target, race_ethnicity, calib_start) %>% 
  summarise(observed = sum(observed, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(target = gsub("inc death", "Deaths", target),
         target = gsub("inc case", "Cases", target)
         ) %>%
  filter(day > 315)

df_compare <- rbind(df_NC, df_NC2)

dt_run <- read_csv("../data/out_data/param_estimate_NC.csv")

#dt_run <- read_csv("save_dt_NC_June8.csv")

## 436 - new variant becomes majority
t_start1 = 119
t_end1 = 455
# t_start2 = 315 ## new npi set
# t_end2 = 436
# t_start3 = 436 ## new variant becomes dominant
# t_end3 = 455

## By March 26, 2021 NPIs are almost completely eased - this is ~132 days from when they were instated

#t_end1 = 160
#t_start2 = 160
#t_end2 = 315

data = calibration_NC
data_calib = calibration_NC
run_parms = NC_parms
run_init = init_NC

paras1 <- run_parms
  #paras1["mu"] <- dt_run$Estimate[1]
  paras1["rr_asian"] <- dt_run$Estimate[1]*dt_run$Estimate[4]
  paras1["rr_black"] <- dt_run$Estimate[2]*dt_run$Estimate[4]
  paras1["rr_other"] <- dt_run$Estimate[3]*dt_run$Estimate[4]
  paras1["rr_white"] <- dt_run$Estimate[4]
  paras1["npi_out_asian"] <- dt_run$Estimate[9] #npi_out_asian_scale*npi_out_white
  paras1["npi_out_black"] <- dt_run$Estimate[9] #npi_out_black_scale*npi_out_white
  paras1["npi_out_other"] <- dt_run$Estimate[9] #npi_out_other_scale*npi_out_white
  paras1["npi_out_white"] <- dt_run$Estimate[9] #npi_out_white
  paras1["sigma1_asian"] <- paras1["sigma1_asian"]*paras1["rr_asian"]
  paras1["sigma1_black"] <- paras1["sigma1_black"]*paras1["rr_black"]
  paras1["sigma1_other"] <- paras1["sigma1_other"]*paras1["rr_other"]
  paras1["sigma1_white"] <- paras1["sigma1_white"]*paras1["rr_white"]
  
  # paras2 <- paras1
  # paras2["mu"] <- dt_run$Estimate[2]
  
  init <- run_init
  
  #To build out initial conditions
  # Currently infected: the reported cases for the week, minus anyone who has died this week
  # Currently dead: all deaths up to this point
  # Currently recovered: all cases up to this point, minus active infections (I), and all deaths up to this point
  # Susceptible: everyone who is left
  
  ## adjust initial infected based on reporting rate - the number infected is the number reported that day divided by reporting rate
  ## remove deaths from past week
  init["I1_asian"] <- init["RepCases_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - 1
  init["I1_black"] <- init["RepCases_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - 29
  init["I1_other"] <- init["RepCases_other"]/paras1["rr_other"] - 2
  init["I1_white"] <- init["RepCases_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - 67
  
  # adjust initial recovered based on reporting rate and deaths ever
  init["R1_asian"] <- init["R1_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - init["D_asian"] - init["I1_asian"]
  init["R1_black"] <- init["R1_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - init["D_black"] - init["I1_black"]
  init["R1_other"] <- init["R1_other"]/paras1["rr_other"] - init["D_other"] - init["I1_other"]
  init["R1_white"] <- init["R1_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - init["D_white"] - init["I1_white"]
  
  # create susceptibles
  init["S1_asian"] <- Pop_Asian_NC - init["I1_asian"] - init["R1_asian"] - init["D_asian"]
  init["S1_black"] <- Pop_Black_NC - init["I1_black"] - init["R1_black"] - init["D_black"]
  init["S1_other"] <- Pop_Other_NC - init["I1_other"] - init["R1_other"] - init["D_other"]
  init["S1_white"] <- Pop_White_NC - init["I1_white"] - init["R1_white"] - init["D_white"]
  
  # set initial 
  
  ## set initial stay at home based on npi1 - just S1, I1, R1
  
  npi_asian = dt_run$Estimate[5]*dt_run$Estimate[8]
  npi_black = dt_run$Estimate[6]*dt_run$Estimate[8]
  npi_other = dt_run$Estimate[7]*dt_run$Estimate[8]
  npi_white = dt_run$Estimate[8]
  
  init["S1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["S1_asian"]
  init["S1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["S1_asian"]
  init["I1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["I1_asian"]
  init["I1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["I1_asian"]
  init["R1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["R1_asian"]
  init["R1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["R1_asian"]
  
  init["S1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["S1_black"]
  init["S1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["S1_black"]
  init["I1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["I1_black"]
  init["I1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["I1_black"]
  init["R1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["R1_black"]
  init["R1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["R1_black"]
  
  init["S1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["S1_other"]
  init["S1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["S1_other"]
  init["I1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["I1_other"]
  init["I1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["I1_other"]
  init["R1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["R1_other"]
  init["R1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["R1_other"]
  
  init["S1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["S1_white"]
  init["S1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["S1_white"]
  init["I1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["I1_white"]
  init["I1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["I1_white"]
  init["R1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["R1_white"]
  init["R1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["R1_white"]
  
  times1 <- seq(t_start1,t_end1, by = 1)
  #times2 <- seq(t_start2,t_end2, by = 1)
  
  out_calib1 <- ode(y=init, func = seir2_nolatino_vax, times=times1, parms = paras1, method = "euler") %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    as_tibble()
  
  # init2 <- out_calib1 %>% 
  #   filter(time == max(time, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  #   select(-time) %>%
  #   unlist()
    
  out_calib1 <- out_calib1 %>%
    pivot_longer(-time) %>% 
    filter(substr(name, 1,1) == "D" | substr(name, 1,2) == "Re") %>% 
    separate(name, into = c("target", "race_ethnicity")) %>%
    mutate(target = case_when(
      target == "D" ~ "Deaths",
      target == "RepCases" ~ "Cases"
    )) %>% 
    select(day = time, target, race_ethnicity, model_predicted = value) %>% 
    inner_join(df_compare, by = c("target", "race_ethnicity", "day")) 
  
  # out_calib2 <- ode(y=init2, func = seir2_nolatino_vax, times=times2, parms = paras2) %>%
  #   as.data.frame() %>%
  #   as_tibble()
  # 
  # out_calib2 <- out_calib2 %>%
  #   pivot_longer(-time) %>% 
  #   filter(substr(name, 1,1) == "D" | substr(name, 1,2) == "Re") %>% 
  #   separate(name, into = c("target", "race_ethnicity")) %>%
  #   mutate(target = case_when(
  #     target == "D" ~ "Deaths",
  #     target == "RepCases" ~ "Cases"
  #   )) %>% 
  #   filter(time != t_start2) %>%
  #   select(day = time, target, race_ethnicity, model_predicted = value) %>% 
  #   inner_join(df_compare, by = c("target", "race_ethnicity", "day")) 
 
 out_calib_full <- out_calib1 #rbind(out_calib1,out_calib2)

plot_out_nc <- out_calib_full %>%
  group_by(target, race_ethnicity) %>% 
  arrange(day) %>% 
  mutate(
    model_predicted = model_predicted - lag(model_predicted)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  #filter(day <= 315) %>%
    mutate(pop = case_when(
    race_ethnicity == "asian" ~ Pop_Asian_NC,
    race_ethnicity == "black" ~ Pop_Black_NC,
    race_ethnicity == "white" ~ Pop_White_NC,
    race_ethnicity == "other" ~ Pop_Other_NC,
  )) %>%
  # group_by(race_ethnicity, target) %>%
  # arrange(day) %>%
  # mutate(
  #   observed = observed_cum - lag(observed_cum),
  #   model_predicted = model_predicted - lag(model_predicted)
  # ) %>%
  # ungroup() %>%
  mutate(date = mindate + day) %>%
   ggplot(aes(x = date)) + 
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 315), linetype = "dashed") +
   geom_point(aes(y = observed, color = race_ethnicity), size = 1, alpha = 0.8) + 
   geom_line(aes(y = model_predicted, color = race_ethnicity), linetype = "solid", size = 1) +
  theme_bw() + 
  ggtitle("Calibration: North Carolina") + 
  facet_grid(target~race_ethnicity, scales = "free") + 
      theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
        plot.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 13.5, face = "bold"),

        plot.margin = unit(c(t=0.2, r=0.2, b=0.2, l=0.2), "cm"),
        legend.key.width= unit(1.2, 'cm'),
        legend.position = "bottom", plot.title.position = "plot",

        strip.text.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11, hjust = 0),
        strip.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 10, hjust = 0),
        strip.background = element_rect(colour="white", fill="white"),

        panel.spacing = unit(0.3, "cm"), aspect.ratio=0.8)
plot_out_nc
```

## Seroprevalence
```{r}

sero_data <- read_csv("../data/serology_data_complete.csv") %>%
  filter(location == 37) %>%
  filter(serology_type == "infection") %>%
  select(race_ethnicity, month, year, region, value, median_donation) %>%
  group_by(race_ethnicity, region) %>%
  arrange(median_donation) %>%
  mutate(smooth_value = rollmean(value, 3, fill = NA)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # group_by(race_ethnicity, median_donation, region) %>%
  # ungroup() %>%
  mutate(median_donation = floor_date(median_donation, "month")) %>% ## Date is floored by month to get a smoothed curve
  mutate(day = difftime(median_donation,run_start-119, "days")) %>% 
  mutate(day = gsub(" days", "", day)) %>%
  mutate(day = as.numeric(day)) %>%
  select(race_ethnicity, day, mean_sero = value, region, smooth_value) %>% 
  group_by(day, race_ethnicity) %>%
  summarise(smooth_mean_sero = mean(smooth_value)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(race_ethnicity != "overall")

df_observed <- df_compare %>%
  filter(target == "Cases") %>%
  select(day, race_ethnicity, observed) %>%
  group_by(race_ethnicity) %>%
  arrange(day) %>%
  mutate(observed_sum = cumsum(observed)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(day, race_ethnicity, observed_sum) 
# 
plot_reported_sero <- df_observed %>%
    mutate(pop = case_when(
    race_ethnicity == "asian" ~ Pop_Asian_NC,
    race_ethnicity == "black" ~ Pop_Black_NC,
    race_ethnicity == "white" ~ Pop_White_NC,
    race_ethnicity == "other" ~ Pop_Other_NC,
  )) %>%
  filter(day < 315) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = day, y = observed_sum/pop)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~race_ethnicity)
plot_reported_sero

    race_ethnicity == "white" ~ dt_run$Estimate[4]
  )) %>%

    race_ethnicity == "asian" ~ Pop_Asian_NC,

  )) %>%
```

## Make latin hypercube sample
```{r}

dt_run <-  read_csv("../data/out_data/param_estimate_NC.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
param_names <- c(#"mu",
                 "rr_asian_scale", "rr_black_scale", "rr_other_scale", "rr_white",
                 "npi_asian_scale", "npi_black_scale", "npi_other_scale", "npi_white")

dt_run <- dt_run %>% 
  mutate(param = c(param_names,"npi_out", "sig_dist")) %>%
  filter(param != "sig_dist", param != "npi_out") %>%
  select(param, Estimate)

dt_profiles <-read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_NC/ rr_asian_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% #read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_NC/ mu .csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  #rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_NC/ rr_asian_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_NC/ rr_black_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_NC/ rr_other_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_NC/ rr_white .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_NC/ npi_asian_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_NC/ npi_black_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_NC/ npi_other_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_NC/ npi_white .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_NC/ npi_out .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  #rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_NC/ sig_dist .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  left_join(dt_run) %>%
  mutate(conf_05 = if_else(
    ll_05 == -10^3, round(conf_05, 2), conf_05
  ),
  conf_95 = if_else(
    ll_95 == -10^3, round(conf_95, 2), conf_95
  )) %>%
  select(name = param, lower = conf_05, upper = conf_95)

rep_num <- 200

draw_lhs <- randomLHS(rep_num, 9) %>%
  as.data.frame()
  ## each is scaled 0-1, need to rescale based on st dev
colnames(draw_lhs) <- c(param_names,"npi_out") 
draw_lhs <- draw_lhs %>% 
  mutate(rep = 1:rep_num) %>%
  pivot_longer(-rep) %>% 
  left_join(dt_profiles) %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
    mutate(lower = max(0, lower),
         upper = max(0,upper)
         ) %>%
  mutate(value2 = rescale(value, to = c(min(lower), max(upper)))) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  select(rep, name, value = value2)


```

```{r}
for (i in 1:rep_num){

df_NC2 <- read_csv("../data/fit/target_data_phase2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%

  mutate(day = gsub(" days", "", day), day = as.numeric(day)) %>% 
  mutate(observed = if_else(target == "inc death", value + min_suppressed, value)) %>% 
  group_by(day, target, race_ethnicity, calib_start) %>% 
  summarise(observed = sum(observed, na.rm = T)) %>%

  mutate(target = gsub("inc death", "Deaths", target),
         target = gsub("inc case", "Cases", target)
         ) %>%

df_compare <- rbind(df_NC, df_NC2)

dt_use <- draw_lhs %>% filter(rep == i) %>%

t_end1 = 455

  compliance_reduction <- 0.85 #0.8 #0.9 #0.8
  
  npi_asian <- compliance_reduction*dt_use$Estimate[5]*dt_use$Estimate[8]
  npi_black <- compliance_reduction*dt_use$Estimate[6]*dt_use$Estimate[8]
  npi_other <- compliance_reduction*dt_use$Estimate[7]*dt_use$Estimate[8]
  npi_white <- compliance_reduction*dt_use$Estimate[8]
  
 paras1["npi_out_asian"] <- dt_use$Estimate[9] #1/132 
 paras1["npi_out_black"] <- dt_use$Estimate[9] #1/132 
 paras1["npi_out_other"] <- dt_use$Estimate[9] #1/132 
 paras1["npi_out_white"] <- dt_use$Estimate[9] #1/132 
  
  init <- run_init
  
  #To build out initial conditions
  # Currently infected: the reported cases for the week, minus anyone who has died this week
  # Currently dead: all deaths up to this point
  # Currently recovered: all cases up to this point, minus active infections (I), and all deaths up to this point
  # Susceptible: everyone who is left
  
  ## adjust initial infected based on reporting rate - the number infected is the number reported that day divided by reporting rate
  ## remove deaths from past week
  init["I1_asian"] <- init["RepCases_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - 0
  init["I1_black"] <- init["RepCases_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - 64
  init["I1_other"] <- init["RepCases_other"]/paras1["rr_other"] - 14
  init["I1_white"] <- init["RepCases_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - 179
  
  # adjust initial recovered based on reporting rate and deaths ever
  init["R1_asian"] <- init["R1_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - init["D_asian"] - init["I1_asian"]
  init["R1_black"] <- init["R1_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - init["D_black"] - init["I1_black"]
  init["R1_other"] <- init["R1_other"]/paras1["rr_other"] - init["D_other"] - init["I1_other"]
  init["R1_white"] <- init["R1_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - init["D_white"] - init["I1_white"]
  
  # create susceptibles
  init["S1_asian"] <- Pop_Asian_NC - init["I1_asian"] - init["R1_asian"] - init["D_asian"]
  init["S1_black"] <- Pop_Black_NC - init["I1_black"] - init["R1_black"] - init["D_black"]
  init["S1_other"] <- Pop_Other_NC - init["I1_other"] - init["R1_other"] - init["D_other"]
  init["S1_white"] <- Pop_White_NC - init["I1_white"] - init["R1_white"] - init["D_white"]
  
## set initial stay at home based on npi1 - just S1, I1, R1. 
  
  init["S1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["S1_asian"]
  init["S1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["S1_asian"]
  init["I1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["I1_asian"]
  init["I1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["I1_asian"]
  init["R1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["R1_asian"]
  init["R1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["R1_asian"]

  init["S1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["S1_black"]
  init["S1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["S1_black"]
  init["I1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["I1_black"]
  init["I1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["I1_black"]
  init["R1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["R1_black"]
  init["R1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["R1_black"]
  
  init["S1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["S1_other"]
  init["S1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["S1_other"]
  init["I1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["I1_other"]
  init["I1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["I1_other"]
  init["R1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["R1_other"]
  init["R1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["R1_other"]
  
  init["S1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["S1_white"]
  init["S1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["S1_white"]
  init["I1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["I1_white"]
  init["I1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["I1_white"]
  init["R1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["R1_white"]
  init["R1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["R1_white"]
  
  #### Run sim 1 ####
 times1 <- seq(t_start1,t_end1, by = 1)

 out_calib1 <- ode(y=init, func = seir2_nolatino_vax, times=times1, parms = paras1, method = "euler") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  as_tibble() 
 
 out_calib1_dat <- out_calib1 %>% 
  pivot_longer(-time) %>% 
  filter(substr(name, 1,1) == "D" | substr(name, 1,2) == "Re") %>% 
  separate(name, into = c("target", "race_ethnicity")) %>%
  mutate(target = case_when(
    target == "D" ~ "Deaths",
    target == "RepCases" ~ "Cases"
  )) %>% 
  select(day = time, target, race_ethnicity, model_predicted = value) %>% 
  inner_join(df_compare, by = c("target", "race_ethnicity", "day"))
 
 
 out_calib_full <- out_calib1_dat %>% mutate(rep = i)

 save_rep_NC <- save_rep_NC %>%
   rbind(out_calib_full)
 
}
```

```{r}
dt_run <-  read_csv("../data/out_data/param_estimate_NC.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
                 "rr_asian_scale", "rr_black_scale", "rr_other_scale", "rr_white",

dt_run <- dt_run %>%

  filter(param != "sig_dist") %>%
  select(param, Estimate)

plot_parms_NC <- dt_run %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = param, values_from = Estimate) %>%
  mutate(rr_asian = rr_asian_scale*rr_white, 
         rr_black = rr_black_scale*rr_white,
         rr_other = rr_other_scale*rr_white,
         npi_asian = npi_asian_scale*npi_white, 
         npi_black = npi_black_scale*npi_white,
         npi_other = npi_other_scale*npi_white,
         sigma1_asian = NC_parms["sigma1_asian"]*rr_asian,
         sigma1_black = NC_parms["sigma1_black"]*rr_black,
         sigma1_other = NC_parms["sigma1_other"]*rr_other,
         sigma1_white = NC_parms["sigma1_white"]*rr_white,
         ) %>%
  select(-rr_asian_scale, -rr_black_scale, -rr_other_scale,
         -npi_asian_scale, -npi_black_scale, -npi_other_scale,
         ) %>%
  pivot_longer(rr_white:sigma1_white, names_to = "param", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(
    substr(param, 1,3) == "npi" & substr(param, 1, 6) != "npi_ou" ~ "NPI compliance",
    substr(param, 1, 6) == "npi_ou" ~ "NPI rate out",
    substr(param, 1,2) == "rr" ~ "Reporting rate",
    param == "mu" ~ "Transmission given contact",
    substr(param, 1,3) == "sig" ~ "Infection fatality rate"
  )) %>%
  separate(param, into = c("tag", "race_ethnicity")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = race_ethnicity, y = value)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + 
  facet_wrap(~type, scales = "free") + 
  ggtitle("Parameters: North Carolina") +
```

```{r}
  paras1["npi_out_black"] <-dt_run$Estimate[11] #dt_run$Estimate[11]*dt_run$Estimate[13]
  paras1["npi_out_latino"] <-dt_run$Estimate[11] #dt_run$Estimate[11]*dt_run$Estimate[13]
  paras1["npi_out_other"] <-dt_run$Estimate[11] #dt_run$Estimate[12]*dt_run$Estimate[13]
  paras1["npi_out_white"] <- dt_run$Estimate[11] #dt_run$Estimate[13]
  paras1["sigma1_asian"] <- paras1["sigma1_asian"]*paras1["rr_asian"]
  paras1["sigma1_black"] <- paras1["sigma1_black"]*paras1["rr_black"]

  paras1["sigma1_other"] <- paras1["sigma1_other"]*paras1["rr_other"]

  init <- run_init
  
#To build out initial conditions
  # Currently infected: the reported cases for the week, minus anyone who has died this week
  # Currently dead: all deaths up to this point
  # Currently recovered: all cases up to this point, minus active infections (I), and all deaths up to this point
  # Susceptible: everyone who is left
  
  ## adjust initial infected based on reporting rate - the number infected is the number reported that day divided by reporting rate
  ## remove deaths from past week
  init["I1_asian"] <- init["RepCases_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - 72
  init["I1_black"] <- init["RepCases_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - 54
  init["I1_latino"] <- init["RepCases_latino"]/paras1["rr_latino"] - 213
  init["I1_other"] <- init["RepCases_other"]/paras1["rr_other"] - 2
  init["I1_white"] <- init["RepCases_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - 174
  
  # adjust initial recovered based on reporting rate and deaths ever
  init["R1_asian"] <- init["R1_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - init["D_asian"] - init["I1_asian"]
  init["R1_black"] <- init["R1_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - init["D_black"] - init["I1_black"]
  init["R1_latino"] <- init["R1_latino"]/paras1["rr_latino"] - init["D_latino"] - init["I1_latino"]
  init["R1_other"] <- init["R1_other"]/paras1["rr_other"] - init["D_other"] - init["I1_other"]
  init["R1_white"] <- init["R1_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - init["D_white"] - init["I1_white"]
  
  # create susceptibles
  init["S1_asian"] <- Pop_Asian_CA - init["I1_asian"] - init["R1_asian"] - init["D_asian"]
  init["S1_black"] <- Pop_Black_CA - init["I1_black"] - init["R1_black"] - init["D_black"]
  init["S1_latino"] <- Pop_Latino_CA - init["I1_latino"] - init["R1_latino"] - init["D_latino"]
  init["S1_other"] <- Pop_Other_CA - init["I1_other"] - init["R1_other"] - init["D_other"]
  init["S1_white"] <- Pop_White_CA - init["I1_white"] - init["R1_white"] - init["D_white"]
  
  
  ## important to do the lockdown calculation first so that the compartment it's scaled off of does not change before rescaling *that* compartment
  init["S1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["S1_asian"]
  init["S1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["S1_asian"]
  init["I1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["I1_asian"]
  init["I1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["I1_asian"]
  init["R1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["R1_asian"]
  init["R1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["R1_asian"]

  init["S1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["S1_black"]
  init["S1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["S1_black"]
  init["I1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["I1_black"]
  init["I1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["I1_black"]
  init["R1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["R1_black"]
  init["R1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["R1_black"]
  
  init["S1_latino_L"] <- npi_latino*init["S1_latino"]
  init["S1_latino"] <- (1-npi_latino)*init["S1_latino"]
  init["I1_latino_L"] <- npi_latino*init["I1_latino"]
  init["I1_latino"] <- (1-npi_latino)*init["I1_latino"]
  init["R1_latino_L"] <- npi_latino*init["R1_latino"]
  init["R1_latino"] <- (1-npi_latino)*init["R1_latino"]
  
  init["S1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["S1_other"]
  init["S1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["S1_other"]
  init["I1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["I1_other"]
  init["I1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["I1_other"]
  init["R1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["R1_other"]
  init["R1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["R1_other"]
  
  init["S1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["S1_white"]
  init["S1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["S1_white"]
  init["I1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["I1_white"]
  init["I1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["I1_white"]
  init["R1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["R1_white"]
  init["R1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["R1_white"]
  
  #### Run sim 1 ####
```

```{r}
dt_run <-  read_csv("../data/out_data/param_estimate_CA.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
param_names <- c(#"mu",
                 "rr_asian_scale", "rr_black_scale", "rr_latino_scale", "rr_other_scale", "rr_white",
                 "npi_asian_scale", "npi_black_scale", "npi_latino_scale", "npi_other_scale", "npi_white", "npi_out")

dt_run <- dt_run %>% 
  mutate(param = c(param_names,"sig_dist")) %>%
  filter(param != "sig_dist") %>%
  select(param, Estimate)

dt_profiles <- read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_CA/ rr_asian_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_CA/ rr_black_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_CA/ rr_latino_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_CA/ rr_other_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_CA/ rr_white .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_CA/ npi_asian_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_CA/ npi_black_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_CA/ npi_latino_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_CA/ npi_other_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_CA/ npi_white .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_CA/ npi_out .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  #rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_NC/ sig_dist .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  left_join(dt_run) %>%
  mutate(conf_05 = if_else(
    ll_05 == -10^3, round(conf_05, 2), conf_05
  ),
  conf_95 = if_else(
    ll_95 == -10^3, round(conf_95, 2), conf_95
  )) %>%
  select(name = param, lower = conf_05, upper = conf_95)

rep_num <- 200

draw_lhs <- randomLHS(rep_num, 11) %>%
  as.data.frame()
  ## each is scaled 0-1, need to rescale based on st dev
colnames(draw_lhs) <- param_names
draw_lhs <- draw_lhs %>% 
  mutate(rep = 1:rep_num) %>%
  pivot_longer(-rep) %>% 
  left_join(dt_profiles) %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
    mutate(lower = max(0, lower),
         upper = max(0,upper)
         ) %>%
  mutate(value2 = rescale(value, to = c(min(lower), max(upper)))) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  select(rep, name, value = value2)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
data = calibration_CA
data_calib = calibration_CA
run_parms = CA_parms
run_init = init_CA

#### first parameter set ####
  paras1 <- run_parms
  #paras1["mu"] <- dt_use$Estimate[1]
  paras1["rr_asian"] <- dt_use$Estimate[1]*dt_use$Estimate[5]
  paras1["rr_black"] <- dt_use$Estimate[2]*dt_use$Estimate[5]
  paras1["rr_latino"] <- dt_use$Estimate[3]*dt_use$Estimate[5]
  paras1["rr_other"] <- dt_use$Estimate[4]*dt_use$Estimate[5]
  paras1["rr_white"] <- dt_use$Estimate[5]
  paras1["npi_out_asian"] <-dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[10]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
  paras1["npi_out_black"] <-dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[11]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
  paras1["npi_out_latino"] <-dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[11]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
  paras1["npi_out_other"] <-dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[12]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
  paras1["npi_out_white"] <-dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[13]
  paras1["sigma1_asian"] <- paras1["sigma1_asian"]*paras1["rr_asian"]
  paras1["sigma1_black"] <- paras1["sigma1_black"]*paras1["rr_black"]
  paras1["sigma1_latino"] <- paras1["sigma1_latino"]*paras1["rr_latino"]
  paras1["sigma1_other"] <- paras1["sigma1_other"]*paras1["rr_other"]
  paras1["sigma1_white"] <- paras1["sigma1_white"]*paras1["rr_white"]
  
   ## there is another npi wave at time 2
 compliance_reduction <- 0.85 #0.9 #0.8
 
  npi_asian <- compliance_reduction*dt_use$Estimate[6]*dt_use$Estimate[10]
  npi_black <- compliance_reduction*dt_use$Estimate[7]*dt_use$Estimate[10]
  npi_latino <- compliance_reduction*dt_use$Estimate[8]*dt_use$Estimate[10]
  npi_other <- compliance_reduction*dt_use$Estimate[9]*dt_use$Estimate[10]
  npi_white <- compliance_reduction*dt_use$Estimate[10]
  
  init <- run_init
  
  ## adjust initial infected based on reporting rate - the number infected is the number reported that day divided by reporting rate
  ## remove deaths from past week
  init["I1_asian"] <- init["RepCases_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - 41
  init["I1_black"] <- init["RepCases_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - 23
  init["I1_latino"] <- init["RepCases_latino"]/paras1["rr_latino"] - 188
  init["I1_other"] <- init["RepCases_other"]/paras1["rr_other"] - 3
  init["I1_white"] <- init["RepCases_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - 154
  
  # adjust initial recovered based on reporting rate and deaths ever
  init["R1_asian"] <- init["R1_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - init["D_asian"] - init["I1_asian"]
  init["R1_black"] <- init["R1_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - init["D_black"] - init["I1_black"]
  init["R1_latino"] <- init["R1_latino"]/paras1["rr_latino"] - init["D_latino"] - init["I1_latino"]
  init["R1_other"] <- init["R1_other"]/paras1["rr_other"] - init["D_other"] - init["I1_other"]
  init["R1_white"] <- init["R1_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - init["D_white"] - init["I1_white"]
  
  # create susceptibles
  init["S1_asian"] <- Pop_Asian_CA - init["I1_asian"] - init["R1_asian"] - init["D_asian"]
  init["S1_black"] <- Pop_Black_CA - init["I1_black"] - init["R1_black"] - init["D_black"]
  init["S1_latino"] <- Pop_Latino_CA - init["I1_latino"] - init["R1_latino"] - init["D_latino"]
  init["S1_other"] <- Pop_Other_CA - init["I1_other"] - init["R1_other"] - init["D_other"]
  init["S1_white"] <- Pop_White_CA - init["I1_white"] - init["R1_white"] - init["D_white"]
  
  # important to do the lockdown calculation first so that the compartment it's scaled off of does not change before rescaling *that* compartment
  init["S1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["S1_asian"]
  init["S1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["S1_asian"]
  init["I1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["I1_asian"]
  init["I1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["I1_asian"]
  init["R1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["R1_asian"]
  init["R1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["R1_asian"]

  init["S1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["S1_black"]
  init["S1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["S1_black"]
  init["I1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["I1_black"]
  init["I1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["I1_black"]
  init["R1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["R1_black"]
  init["R1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["R1_black"]

  init["S1_latino_L"] <- npi_latino*init["S1_latino"]
  init["S1_latino"] <- (1-npi_latino)*init["S1_latino"]
  init["I1_latino_L"] <- npi_latino*init["I1_latino"]
  init["I1_latino"] <- (1-npi_latino)*init["I1_latino"]
  init["R1_latino_L"] <- npi_latino*init["R1_latino"]
  init["R1_latino"] <- (1-npi_latino)*init["R1_latino"]

  init["S1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["S1_other"]
  init["S1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["S1_other"]
  init["I1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["I1_other"]
  init["I1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["I1_other"]
  init["R1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["R1_other"]
  init["R1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["R1_other"]

  init["S1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["S1_white"]
  init["S1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["S1_white"]
  init["I1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["I1_white"]
  init["I1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["I1_white"]
  init["R1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["R1_white"]
  init["R1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["R1_white"]
  
  #### Run sim 1 ####
 times1 <- seq(t_start1,t_end1, by = 1)

 out_calib1 <- ode(y=init, func = seir2_vax, times=times1, parms = paras1, method = "euler") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  as_tibble() 
 
 out_calib1_dat <- out_calib1 %>% 
  pivot_longer(-time) %>% 
  filter(substr(name, 1,1) == "D" | substr(name, 1,2) == "Re") %>% 
  separate(name, into = c("target", "race_ethnicity")) %>%
  mutate(target = case_when(
    target == "D" ~ "Deaths",
    target == "RepCases" ~ "Cases"
  )) %>% 
  select(day = time, target, race_ethnicity, model_predicted = value) %>% 
  inner_join(df_compare, by = c("target", "race_ethnicity", "day"))
 
 
 out_calib_full <- out_calib1_dat %>%
   mutate(rep = i)
 
 save_rep_CA <- save_rep_CA %>% rbind(out_calib_full)
 
}
```

```{r}
  left_join(dt_run) %>%
  mutate(conf_05 = if_else(

  ),

  )) %>%
  select(name = param, lower = conf_05, upper = conf_95)

rep_num <- 200

draw_lhs <- randomLHS(rep_num, 9) %>%
  as.data.frame()
  ## each is scaled 0-1, need to rescale based on st dev
colnames(draw_lhs) <- c(param_names,"npi_out") 
draw_lhs <- draw_lhs %>% 
  mutate(rep = 1:rep_num) %>%
  pivot_longer(-rep) %>% 
  left_join(dt_profiles) %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
    mutate(lower = max(0, lower),
         upper = max(0,upper)
         ) %>%
  mutate(value2 = rescale(value, to = c(min(lower), max(upper)))) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  select(rep, name, value = value2)
```

### Run output
```{r}

save_rep_NC <- tibble(NULL)

for (i in 1:rep_num){

run_start <- as.Date("5-1-2020", "%m-%d-%Y")

df_NC2 <- read_csv("../data/fit/target_data_phase2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
  filter(location == 37) %>%
  mutate(calib_start = difftime(run_start, min(date), units = "days")) %>%
  mutate(day = difftime(date, min(date), units = "days")) %>% 
  mutate(day = gsub(" days", "", day), day = as.numeric(day)) %>% 
  mutate(observed = if_else(target == "inc death", value + min_suppressed, value)) %>% 
  group_by(day, target, race_ethnicity, calib_start) %>% 
  summarise(observed = sum(observed, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(target = gsub("inc death", "Deaths", target),
         target = gsub("inc case", "Cases", target)
         ) %>%
  filter(day > 315)

df_compare <- rbind(df_NC, df_NC2)

dt_use <- draw_lhs %>% filter(rep == i) %>% 
  rename(Estimate = value)

#dt_run <- read_csv("save_dt_NC_June8.csv")

## 436 - new variant becomes majority
t_start1 = 315 ## new npi set
t_end1 = 455

## By March 26, 2021 NPIs are almost completely eased - this is ~132 days from when they were instated


data = calibration_NC
data_calib = calibration_NC
run_parms = NC_parms
run_init = init_NC

#### first parameter set ####
  paras1 <- run_parms
  #paras1["mu"] <- dt_use$Estimate[1]
  paras1["rr_asian"] <- dt_use$Estimate[1]*dt_use$Estimate[4]
  paras1["rr_black"] <- dt_use$Estimate[2]*dt_use$Estimate[4]
  paras1["rr_other"] <- dt_use$Estimate[3]*dt_use$Estimate[4]
  paras1["rr_white"] <- dt_use$Estimate[4]
  # paras1["npi_out_asian"] <-dt_use$Estimate[10] #dt_use$Estimate[10]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
  # paras1["npi_out_black"] <-dt_use$Estimate[10] #dt_use$Estimate[11]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
  # paras1["npi_out_other"] <-dt_use$Estimate[10] #dt_use$Estimate[12]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
  # paras1["npi_out_white"] <-dt_use$Estimate[10] #dt_use$Estimate[13]
  paras1["sigma1_asian"] <- paras1["sigma1_asian"]*paras1["rr_asian"]
  paras1["sigma1_black"] <- paras1["sigma1_black"]*paras1["rr_black"]
  paras1["sigma1_other"] <- paras1["sigma1_other"]*paras1["rr_other"]
  paras1["sigma1_white"] <- paras1["sigma1_white"]*paras1["rr_white"]
  
  compliance_reduction <- 0.85 #0.8 #0.9 #0.8
  
  npi_asian <- compliance_reduction*dt_use$Estimate[5]*dt_use$Estimate[8]
  npi_black <- compliance_reduction*dt_use$Estimate[6]*dt_use$Estimate[8]
  npi_other <- compliance_reduction*dt_use$Estimate[7]*dt_use$Estimate[8]
  npi_white <- compliance_reduction*dt_use$Estimate[8]
  
 paras1["npi_out_asian"] <- dt_use$Estimate[9] #1/132 
 paras1["npi_out_black"] <- dt_use$Estimate[9] #1/132 
 paras1["npi_out_other"] <- dt_use$Estimate[9] #1/132 
 paras1["npi_out_white"] <- dt_use$Estimate[9] #1/132 
  
  init <- run_init
  
  #To build out initial conditions
  # Currently infected: the reported cases for the week, minus anyone who has died this week
  # Currently dead: all deaths up to this point
  # Currently recovered: all cases up to this point, minus active infections (I), and all deaths up to this point
  # Susceptible: everyone who is left
  
  ## adjust initial infected based on reporting rate - the number infected is the number reported that day divided by reporting rate
  ## remove deaths from past week
  init["I1_asian"] <- init["RepCases_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - 0
  init["I1_black"] <- init["RepCases_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - 64
  init["I1_other"] <- init["RepCases_other"]/paras1["rr_other"] - 14
  init["I1_white"] <- init["RepCases_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - 179
  
  # adjust initial recovered based on reporting rate and deaths ever
  init["R1_asian"] <- init["R1_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - init["D_asian"] - init["I1_asian"]
  init["R1_black"] <- init["R1_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - init["D_black"] - init["I1_black"]
  init["R1_other"] <- init["R1_other"]/paras1["rr_other"] - init["D_other"] - init["I1_other"]
  init["R1_white"] <- init["R1_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - init["D_white"] - init["I1_white"]
  
  # create susceptibles
  init["S1_asian"] <- Pop_Asian_NC - init["I1_asian"] - init["R1_asian"] - init["D_asian"]
  init["S1_black"] <- Pop_Black_NC - init["I1_black"] - init["R1_black"] - init["D_black"]
  init["S1_other"] <- Pop_Other_NC - init["I1_other"] - init["R1_other"] - init["D_other"]
  init["S1_white"] <- Pop_White_NC - init["I1_white"] - init["R1_white"] - init["D_white"]
  
## set initial stay at home based on npi1 - just S1, I1, R1. 
  
  init["S1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["S1_asian"]
  init["S1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["S1_asian"]
  init["I1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["I1_asian"]
  init["I1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["I1_asian"]
  init["R1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["R1_asian"]
  init["R1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["R1_asian"]

  init["S1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["S1_black"]
  init["S1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["S1_black"]
  init["I1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["I1_black"]
  init["I1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["I1_black"]
  init["R1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["R1_black"]
  init["R1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["R1_black"]
  
  init["S1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["S1_other"]
  init["S1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["S1_other"]
  init["I1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["I1_other"]
  init["I1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["I1_other"]
  init["R1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["R1_other"]
  init["R1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["R1_other"]
  
  init["S1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["S1_white"]
  init["S1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["S1_white"]
  init["I1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["I1_white"]
  init["I1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["I1_white"]
  init["R1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["R1_white"]
  init["R1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["R1_white"]
  
  #### Run sim 1 ####
 times1 <- seq(t_start1,t_end1, by = 1)

 out_calib1 <- ode(y=init, func = seir2_nolatino_vax, times=times1, parms = paras1, method = "euler") %>%
```

```{r}
  left_join(dt_run) %>%
  mutate(conf_05 = if_else(
    ll_05 == -10^3, round(conf_05, 2), conf_05
  ),
  conf_95 = if_else(
    ll_95 == -10^3, round(conf_95, 2), conf_95
  )) %>%
  select(name = param, lower = conf_05, upper = conf_95)

rep_num <- 200

draw_lhs <- randomLHS(rep_num, 11) %>%
  as.data.frame()
  ## each is scaled 0-1, need to rescale based on st dev
colnames(draw_lhs) <- param_names
draw_lhs <- draw_lhs %>% 
  mutate(rep = 1:rep_num) %>%
  pivot_longer(-rep) %>% 
  left_join(dt_profiles) %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
    mutate(lower = max(0, lower),
         upper = max(0,upper)
         ) %>%
  mutate(value2 = rescale(value, to = c(min(lower), max(upper)))) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  select(rep, name, value = value2)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
  init <- run_init
  
  ## adjust initial infected based on reporting rate - the number infected is the number reported that day divided by reporting rate
  ## remove deaths from past week
  init["I1_asian"] <- init["RepCases_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - 41
  init["I1_black"] <- init["RepCases_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - 23

  init["I1_white"] <- init["RepCases_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - 154
```

```{r}
  filter(param != "sig_dist", param != "npi_out") %>%
  select(param, Estimate)

dt_profiles <-read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_NC/ rr_asian_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% #read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_NC/ mu .csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  #rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_NC/ rr_asian_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_NC/ rr_black_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_NC/ rr_other_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_NC/ rr_white .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_NC/ npi_asian_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_NC/ npi_black_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_NC/ npi_other_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_NC/ npi_white .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_NC/ npi_out .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  #rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_NC/ sig_dist .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  left_join(dt_run) %>%
  mutate(conf_05 = if_else(
    ll_05 == -10^3, round(conf_05, 2), conf_05
  ),
  conf_95 = if_else(
    ll_95 == -10^3, round(conf_95, 2), conf_95
  )) %>%
  select(name = param, lower = conf_05, upper = conf_95) %>%
  rbind(c("comp_red", 0.8, 1.2)) ## add npi change uncertainty

rep_num <- 200

draw_lhs <- randomLHS(rep_num, 10) %>%
  as.data.frame()
  ## each is scaled 0-1, need to rescale based on st dev
colnames(draw_lhs) <- c(param_names,"npi_out", "comp_red") 
draw_lhs <- draw_lhs %>% 
  mutate(rep = 1:rep_num) %>%
  pivot_longer(-rep) %>% 
  left_join(dt_profiles) %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
    mutate(lower = as.numeric(max(0, lower)),
         upper = as.numeric(max(0,upper))
         ) %>%
  mutate(value2 = rescale(value, to = c(min(lower), max(upper)))) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  select(rep, name, value = value2)
```

### Run output
```{r}

save_rep_NC <- tibble(NULL)

for (i in 1:rep_num){

run_start <- as.Date("5-1-2020", "%m-%d-%Y")

df_NC2 <- read_csv("../data/fit/target_data_phase2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
  filter(location == 37) %>%
  mutate(calib_start = difftime(run_start, min(date), units = "days")) %>%
  mutate(day = difftime(date, min(date), units = "days")) %>% 
  mutate(day = gsub(" days", "", day), day = as.numeric(day)) %>% 
  mutate(observed = if_else(target == "inc death", value + min_suppressed, value)) %>% 
  group_by(day, target, race_ethnicity, calib_start) %>% 
  summarise(observed = sum(observed, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(target = gsub("inc death", "Deaths", target),
         target = gsub("inc case", "Cases", target)
         ) %>%
  filter(day > 315)

df_compare <- rbind(df_NC, df_NC2)

dt_use <- draw_lhs %>% filter(rep == i) %>% 
  rename(Estimate = value)

#dt_run <- read_csv("save_dt_NC_June8.csv")

## 436 - new variant becomes majority
t_start1 = 315 ## new npi set
t_end1 = 455

## By March 26, 2021 NPIs are almost completely eased - this is ~132 days from when they were instated


data = calibration_NC
data_calib = calibration_NC
run_parms = NC_parms
run_init = init_NC

#### first parameter set ####
  paras1 <- run_parms
  #paras1["mu"] <- dt_use$Estimate[1]
  paras1["rr_asian"] <- dt_use$Estimate[1]*dt_use$Estimate[4]
  paras1["rr_black"] <- dt_use$Estimate[2]*dt_use$Estimate[4]
  paras1["rr_other"] <- dt_use$Estimate[3]*dt_use$Estimate[4]
  paras1["rr_white"] <- dt_use$Estimate[4]
  # paras1["npi_out_asian"] <-dt_use$Estimate[10] #dt_use$Estimate[10]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
  # paras1["npi_out_black"] <-dt_use$Estimate[10] #dt_use$Estimate[11]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
  # paras1["npi_out_other"] <-dt_use$Estimate[10] #dt_use$Estimate[12]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
  # paras1["npi_out_white"] <-dt_use$Estimate[10] #dt_use$Estimate[13]
  paras1["sigma1_asian"] <- paras1["sigma1_asian"]*paras1["rr_asian"]
  paras1["sigma1_black"] <- paras1["sigma1_black"]*paras1["rr_black"]
  paras1["sigma1_other"] <- paras1["sigma1_other"]*paras1["rr_other"]
  paras1["sigma1_white"] <- paras1["sigma1_white"]*paras1["rr_white"]
  
  compliance_reduction <- dt_use$Estimate[10]
  
  npi_asian <- compliance_reduction*dt_use$Estimate[5]*dt_use$Estimate[8]
  npi_black <- compliance_reduction*dt_use$Estimate[6]*dt_use$Estimate[8]
  npi_other <- compliance_reduction*dt_use$Estimate[7]*dt_use$Estimate[8]
  npi_white <- compliance_reduction*dt_use$Estimate[8]
  
 paras1["npi_out_asian"] <- dt_use$Estimate[9] #1/132 
 paras1["npi_out_black"] <- dt_use$Estimate[9] #1/132 
 paras1["npi_out_other"] <- dt_use$Estimate[9] #1/132 
 paras1["npi_out_white"] <- dt_use$Estimate[9] #1/132 
  
  init <- run_init
  
  #To build out initial conditions
  # Currently infected: the reported cases for the week, minus anyone who has died this week
  # Currently dead: all deaths up to this point
  # Currently recovered: all cases up to this point, minus active infections (I), and all deaths up to this point
  # Susceptible: everyone who is left
  
  ## adjust initial infected based on reporting rate - the number infected is the number reported that day divided by reporting rate
  ## remove deaths from past week
  init["I1_asian"] <- init["RepCases_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - 0
  init["I1_black"] <- init["RepCases_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - 64
  init["I1_other"] <- init["RepCases_other"]/paras1["rr_other"] - 14
  init["I1_white"] <- init["RepCases_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - 179
  
  # adjust initial recovered based on reporting rate and deaths ever
  init["R1_asian"] <- init["R1_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - init["D_asian"] - init["I1_asian"]
  init["R1_black"] <- init["R1_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - init["D_black"] - init["I1_black"]
  init["R1_other"] <- init["R1_other"]/paras1["rr_other"] - init["D_other"] - init["I1_other"]
  init["R1_white"] <- init["R1_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - init["D_white"] - init["I1_white"]
  
  # create susceptibles
  init["S1_asian"] <- Pop_Asian_NC - init["I1_asian"] - init["R1_asian"] - init["D_asian"]
  init["S1_black"] <- Pop_Black_NC - init["I1_black"] - init["R1_black"] - init["D_black"]
  init["S1_other"] <- Pop_Other_NC - init["I1_other"] - init["R1_other"] - init["D_other"]
  init["S1_white"] <- Pop_White_NC - init["I1_white"] - init["R1_white"] - init["D_white"]
  
## set initial stay at home based on npi1 - just S1, I1, R1. 
  
  init["S1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["S1_asian"]
  init["S1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["S1_asian"]
  init["I1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["I1_asian"]
  init["I1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["I1_asian"]
  init["R1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["R1_asian"]
  init["R1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["R1_asian"]

  init["S1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["S1_black"]
  init["S1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["S1_black"]
  init["I1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["I1_black"]
  init["I1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["I1_black"]
  init["R1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["R1_black"]
  init["R1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["R1_black"]
  
  init["S1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["S1_other"]
  init["S1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["S1_other"]
  init["I1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["I1_other"]
  init["I1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["I1_other"]
  init["R1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["R1_other"]
  init["R1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["R1_other"]
  
  init["S1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["S1_white"]
  init["S1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["S1_white"]
  init["I1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["I1_white"]
  init["I1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["I1_white"]
  init["R1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["R1_white"]
  init["R1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["R1_white"]
  
  #### Run sim 1 ####
 times1 <- seq(t_start1,t_end1, by = 1)

 out_calib1 <- ode(y=init, func = seir2_nolatino_vax, times=times1, parms = paras1, method = "euler") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  as_tibble() 
 
 out_calib1_dat <- out_calib1 %>% 
  pivot_longer(-time) %>% 
  filter(substr(name, 1,1) == "D" | substr(name, 1,2) == "Re" | 
           substr(name, 1, 2) == "In") %>%
           #substr(name, 1,2) == "I1" | substr(name, 1, 2) == "I2") %>% 
  separate(name, into = c("target", "race_ethnicity")) %>%
  mutate(target = case_when(
    target == "D" ~ "inc death",
    target == "RepCases" ~ "inc case",
    target == "Inc" ~ "inc inf"
  )) %>% 
   group_by(time, race_ethnicity, target) %>%
   reframe(value = sum(value, na.rm = T)) %>%
   ungroup() %>%
   #filter(target %in% c("inc death", "inc inf")) %>%
  select(day = time, target, race_ethnicity, model_predicted = value)
 
 
 out_calib_full <- out_calib1_dat %>% mutate(rep = i)

 save_rep_NC <- save_rep_NC %>%
   rbind(out_calib_full)
 
}
```

### Final file
```{r}
final_run_data_NC <- save_rep_NC %>%
  group_by(race_ethnicity, target, rep) %>%
  arrange(day) %>%
  mutate(model_predicted = model_predicted - lag(model_predicted)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(day >= 316) %>%
  mutate(date = day + mindate) %>%
  mutate(MMWRweek(date)) %>%
  group_by(MMWRweek, MMWRyear, target, race_ethnicity, rep) %>%
  reframe(value = sum(model_predicted)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(origin_date = MMWRweek2Date(MMWRyear, MMWRweek, MMWRday = NULL)) %>%
  select(origin_date, race_ethnicity, target, value, run_grouping = rep) %>%
  mutate(horizon = difftime(origin_date, min(origin_date), units = "weeks"),
         horizon = gsub(" weeks", "", horizon),
         horizon = as.numeric(horizon) + 1
         ) %>%
  mutate(scenario_id = "A-2020-05-01", 
         location = "37",
         output_type = "sample",
         output_type_id = NA
         ) %>%
  mutate(stochastic_run = 1) %>%
  select(origin_date, scenario_id, target, horizon, location, race_ethnicity, output_type, output_type_id, value, run_grouping, stochastic_run) %>% 
  mutate(origin_date = min(origin_date))
```

### Make latin hypercube sample
```{r}

dt_run <-  read_csv("../data/out_data/param_estimate_CA.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
param_names <- c(#"mu",
                 "rr_asian_scale", "rr_black_scale", "rr_latino_scale", "rr_other_scale", "rr_white",
                 "npi_asian_scale", "npi_black_scale", "npi_latino_scale", "npi_other_scale", "npi_white", "npi_out")

dt_run <- dt_run %>% 
  mutate(param = c(param_names,"sig_dist")) %>%
  filter(param != "sig_dist") %>%
  select(param, Estimate)

dt_profiles <- read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_CA/ rr_asian_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_CA/ rr_black_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_CA/ rr_latino_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_CA/ rr_other_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_CA/ rr_white .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_CA/ npi_asian_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_CA/ npi_black_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_CA/ npi_latino_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_CA/ npi_other_scale .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_CA/ npi_white .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_CA/ npi_out .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  #rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_out_data_NC/ sig_dist .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  left_join(dt_run) %>%
  mutate(conf_05 = if_else(
    ll_05 == -10^3, round(conf_05, 2), conf_05
  ),
  conf_95 = if_else(
    ll_95 == -10^3, round(conf_95, 2), conf_95
  )) %>%
  select(name = param, lower = conf_05, upper = conf_95) %>%
  rbind(c("comp_red", 0.8, 1.2)) ## add npi change uncertainty


rep_num <- 200

draw_lhs <- randomLHS(rep_num, 12) %>%
  as.data.frame()
  ## each is scaled 0-1, need to rescale based on st dev
colnames(draw_lhs) <- c(param_names,"comp_red")
draw_lhs <- draw_lhs %>% 
  mutate(rep = 1:rep_num) %>%
  pivot_longer(-rep) %>% 
  left_join(dt_profiles) %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
    mutate(lower = as.numeric(max(0, lower)),
         upper = as.numeric(max(0,upper))
         ) %>%
  mutate(value2 = rescale(value, to = c(min(lower), max(upper)))) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  select(rep, name, value = value2)


```

### Run output
```{r, include=FALSE}

save_rep_CA <- tibble(NULL)

for (i in 1:rep_num){

run_start <- as.Date("5-1-2020", "%m-%d-%Y")

df_CA2 <- read_csv("../data/fit/target_data_phase2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
  filter(location != 37) %>%
  mutate(calib_start = difftime(run_start, min(date), units = "days")) %>%
  mutate(day = difftime(date, min(date), units = "days")) %>% 
  mutate(day = gsub(" days", "", day), day = as.numeric(day)) %>% 
  mutate(observed = if_else(target == "inc death", value + min_suppressed, value)) %>% 
  group_by(day, target, race_ethnicity, calib_start) %>% 
  summarise(observed = sum(observed, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(target = gsub("inc death", "Deaths", target),
         target = gsub("inc case", "Cases", target)
         ) %>%
  filter(day > 315)

df_compare <- rbind(df_CA, df_CA2)

dt_use <- draw_lhs %>% filter(rep == i) %>% 
  rename(Estimate = value)

#dt_run <- read_csv("save_dt_NC_June8.csv")

## 436 - new variant becomes majority
t_start1 = 315
t_end1 <- 455

## By Jan 25, 2021 NPIs are almost completely eased - this is ~70 days from when they were instated

#t_end1 = 160
#t_start2 = 160
#t_end2 = 315

data = calibration_CA
data_calib = calibration_CA
run_parms = CA_parms
run_init = init_CA

#### first parameter set ####
  paras1 <- run_parms
  #paras1["mu"] <- dt_use$Estimate[1]
  paras1["rr_asian"] <- dt_use$Estimate[1]*dt_use$Estimate[5]
  paras1["rr_black"] <- dt_use$Estimate[2]*dt_use$Estimate[5]
  paras1["rr_latino"] <- dt_use$Estimate[3]*dt_use$Estimate[5]
  paras1["rr_other"] <- dt_use$Estimate[4]*dt_use$Estimate[5]
  paras1["rr_white"] <- dt_use$Estimate[5]
  paras1["npi_out_asian"] <-dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[10]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
  paras1["npi_out_black"] <-dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[11]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
  paras1["npi_out_latino"] <-dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[11]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
  paras1["npi_out_other"] <-dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[12]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
  paras1["npi_out_white"] <-dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[13]
  paras1["sigma1_asian"] <- paras1["sigma1_asian"]*paras1["rr_asian"]
  paras1["sigma1_black"] <- paras1["sigma1_black"]*paras1["rr_black"]
  paras1["sigma1_latino"] <- paras1["sigma1_latino"]*paras1["rr_latino"]
  paras1["sigma1_other"] <- paras1["sigma1_other"]*paras1["rr_other"]
  paras1["sigma1_white"] <- paras1["sigma1_white"]*paras1["rr_white"]
  
   ## there is another npi wave 
 compliance_reduction <- dt_use$Estimate[12] #0.85 #0.9 #0.8
 
  npi_asian <- compliance_reduction*dt_use$Estimate[6]*dt_use$Estimate[10]
  npi_black <- compliance_reduction*dt_use$Estimate[7]*dt_use$Estimate[10]
  npi_latino <- compliance_reduction*dt_use$Estimate[8]*dt_use$Estimate[10]
  npi_other <- compliance_reduction*dt_use$Estimate[9]*dt_use$Estimate[10]
  npi_white <- compliance_reduction*dt_use$Estimate[10]
  
  init <- run_init
  
  ## adjust initial infected based on reporting rate - the number infected is the number reported that day divided by reporting rate
  ## remove deaths from past week
  init["I1_asian"] <- init["RepCases_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - 41
  init["I1_black"] <- init["RepCases_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - 23
  init["I1_latino"] <- init["RepCases_latino"]/paras1["rr_latino"] - 188
  init["I1_other"] <- init["RepCases_other"]/paras1["rr_other"] - 3
  init["I1_white"] <- init["RepCases_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - 154
  
  # adjust initial recovered based on reporting rate and deaths ever
  init["R1_asian"] <- init["R1_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - init["D_asian"] - init["I1_asian"]
  init["R1_black"] <- init["R1_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - init["D_black"] - init["I1_black"]
  init["R1_latino"] <- init["R1_latino"]/paras1["rr_latino"] - init["D_latino"] - init["I1_latino"]
  init["R1_other"] <- init["R1_other"]/paras1["rr_other"] - init["D_other"] - init["I1_other"]
  init["R1_white"] <- init["R1_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - init["D_white"] - init["I1_white"]
  
  # create susceptibles
  init["S1_asian"] <- Pop_Asian_CA - init["I1_asian"] - init["R1_asian"] - init["D_asian"]
  init["S1_black"] <- Pop_Black_CA - init["I1_black"] - init["R1_black"] - init["D_black"]
  init["S1_latino"] <- Pop_Latino_CA - init["I1_latino"] - init["R1_latino"] - init["D_latino"]
  init["S1_other"] <- Pop_Other_CA - init["I1_other"] - init["R1_other"] - init["D_other"]
  init["S1_white"] <- Pop_White_CA - init["I1_white"] - init["R1_white"] - init["D_white"]
  
  # # important to do the lockdown calculation first so that the compartment it's scaled off of does not change before rescaling *that* compartment
  init["S1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["S1_asian"]
  init["S1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["S1_asian"]
  init["I1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["I1_asian"]
  init["I1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["I1_asian"]
  init["R1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["R1_asian"]
  init["R1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["R1_asian"]

  init["S1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["S1_black"]
  init["S1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["S1_black"]
  init["I1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["I1_black"]
  init["I1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["I1_black"]
  init["R1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["R1_black"]
  init["R1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["R1_black"]

  init["S1_latino_L"] <- npi_latino*init["S1_latino"]
  init["S1_latino"] <- (1-npi_latino)*init["S1_latino"]
  init["I1_latino_L"] <- npi_latino*init["I1_latino"]
  init["I1_latino"] <- (1-npi_latino)*init["I1_latino"]
  init["R1_latino_L"] <- npi_latino*init["R1_latino"]
  init["R1_latino"] <- (1-npi_latino)*init["R1_latino"]

  init["S1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["S1_other"]
  init["S1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["S1_other"]
  init["I1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["I1_other"]
  init["I1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["I1_other"]
  init["R1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["R1_other"]
  init["R1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["R1_other"]

  init["S1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["S1_white"]
  init["S1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["S1_white"]
  init["I1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["I1_white"]
  init["I1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["I1_white"]
  init["R1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["R1_white"]
  init["R1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["R1_white"]
  
  #### Run sim 1 ####
 times1 <- seq(t_start1,t_end1, by = 1)

 out_calib1 <- ode(y=init, func = seir2_vax, times=times1, parms = paras1, method = "euler") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  as_tibble() 

 
 out_calib1_dat <- out_calib1 %>% 
  pivot_longer(-time) %>% 
  filter(substr(name, 1,1) == "D" | substr(name, 1,2) == "Re" | 
           substr(name, 1, 2) == "In") %>%
           #substr(name, 1,2) == "I1" | substr(name, 1, 2) == "I2") %>% 
  separate(name, into = c("target", "race_ethnicity")) %>%
  mutate(target = case_when(
    target == "D" ~ "inc death",
    target == "RepCases" ~ "inc case",
    target == "Inc" ~ "inc inf"
  )) %>% 
   group_by(time, race_ethnicity, target) %>%
   reframe(value = sum(value, na.rm = T)) %>%
   ungroup() %>%
   #filter(target %in% c("inc death", "inc inf")) %>%
  select(day = time, target, race_ethnicity, model_predicted = value)
 
 out_calib_full <- out_calib1_dat %>%
   mutate(rep = i)
 
 save_rep_CA <- save_rep_CA %>% rbind(out_calib_full)
 
}
```

### Final file
```{r}
final_run_data_CA <- save_rep_CA %>%
  group_by(race_ethnicity, target, rep) %>%
  arrange(day) %>%
  mutate(model_predicted = model_predicted - lag(model_predicted)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(day >= 316) %>%
  mutate(date = day + mindate) %>%
  mutate(MMWRweek(date)) %>%
  group_by(MMWRweek, MMWRyear, target, race_ethnicity, rep) %>%
  reframe(value = sum(model_predicted)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(origin_date = MMWRweek2Date(MMWRyear, MMWRweek, MMWRday = NULL)) %>%
  select(origin_date, race_ethnicity, target, value, run_grouping = rep) %>%
  mutate(horizon = difftime(origin_date, min(origin_date), units = "weeks"),
         horizon = gsub(" weeks", "", horizon),
         horizon = as.numeric(horizon) + 1
         ) %>%
  mutate(scenario_id = "A-2020-05-01", 
         location = "06",
         output_type = "sample",
         output_type_id = NA
         ) %>%
  mutate(stochastic_run = 1) %>%
  select(origin_date, scenario_id, target, horizon, location, race_ethnicity, output_type, output_type_id, value, run_grouping, stochastic_run) %>% 
  mutate(origin_date = min(origin_date))
```

## Write for submission
```{r}
df_submit <- rbind(final_run_data_CA, final_run_data_NC) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "race_ethnicity", values_from = "value") %>%
  mutate(overall = 
           if_else(location == "06",
           asian + black + latino + other + white,
           asian + black + other + white
           )
         ) %>%
  pivot_longer(asian:overall, names_to = "race_ethnicity", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  mutate(run_grouping = if_else(location == "37", 200 + run_grouping, run_grouping)) %>%
  select(origin_date, scenario_id, target, horizon, location, race_ethnicity, output_type, output_type_id, value, run_grouping, stochastic_run) %>%
  mutate(origin_date = as.character(origin_date),
         horizon = as.integer(horizon),
         output_type_id = as.character(output_type_id),
         run_grouping = as.integer(run_grouping),
         stochastic_run = as.integer(stochastic_run)
         )

plot_out <- df_submit %>%
  filter(target == "inc death") %>%
  group_by(race_ethnicity, target,location, horizon) %>%
  summarise(value = mean(value)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = horizon, y = value, color = race_ethnicity)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  facet_grid(location~target, scales = "free")
plot_out
```

```{r}

## Get population age structure
pop_structure_ca <- read_csv("../covid19-smh-research_resources-main/disparities/population_data/joint_population_data.csv") %>%
  filter(location != 37) %>% ## filter for this state
  select(race_ethnicity, age, percent, total_population) %>%
  mutate(group_pop = percent*total_population) %>%  ## get number in each grouping
  mutate(age_cutoff = if_else(age == "65+", "over 65", "under 65")) %>% ## group by over/under 65
  group_by(race_ethnicity, age_cutoff) %>% 
  summarise(group_pop = sum(group_pop)) %>% ## get total under/over 65
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(race_ethnicity) %>%
  mutate(total_pop = sum(group_pop)) %>% ## get total for each race/ethnicity
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(age_perc = group_pop/total_pop) ## get percentage in each age group for each race/ethnicity

get_death_num <- df_CA_phase2 %>% 
  filter(target == "Deaths") %>%
  group_by(race_ethnicity) %>%
  arrange(day) %>%
  mutate(observed_cum = cumsum(observed)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(day == "455") %>%
  select(race_ethnicity, deaths = observed_cum)

deaths_100k <- get_death_num %>%
    mutate(pop = case_when(
    race_ethnicity == "asian" ~ Pop_Asian_CA,
    race_ethnicity == "black" ~ Pop_Black_CA,
    race_ethnicity == "latino" ~ Pop_Latino_CA,
    race_ethnicity == "other" ~ Pop_Other_CA,
    race_ethnicity == "white" ~ Pop_White_CA,
  )) %>%
  mutate(deaths_100k = 100000*deaths/pop)

run_start <- as.Date("5-1-2020", "%m-%d-%Y")
IFR_serology_ca <- read_csv("../data/serology_data_complete.csv") %>%
  filter(location != 37) %>%
  filter(serology_type == "infection") %>%
  select(race_ethnicity, month, year, region, value, median_donation) %>%
  group_by(race_ethnicity, region) %>% ## smooth rolling mean by each region
  arrange(median_donation) %>%
  mutate(smooth_value = rollmean(value, 3, fill = NA)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # group_by(race_ethnicity, median_donation, region) %>%
  # ungroup() %>%
  mutate(median_donation = floor_date(median_donation, "month")) %>% ## Date is floored by month to get a smoothed curve
  mutate(day = difftime(median_donation,run_start-119, "days")) %>% 
  mutate(day = gsub(" days", "", day)) %>%
  mutate(day = as.numeric(day)) %>%
  select(race_ethnicity, day, mean_sero = value, region, smooth_value) %>% 
  group_by(day, race_ethnicity) %>%   # average of rolling means (aggregate regions)
  summarise(smooth_mean_sero = mean(smooth_value)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(race_ethnicity != "overall") %>%
  filter(day == "454") %>%
  mutate(pop = case_when(
    race_ethnicity == "asian" ~ Pop_Asian_CA,
    race_ethnicity == "black" ~ Pop_Black_CA,
    race_ethnicity == "latino" ~ Pop_Latino_CA,
    race_ethnicity == "other" ~ Pop_Other_CA,
    race_ethnicity == "white" ~ Pop_White_CA,
  )) %>%
  mutate(infections = smooth_mean_sero*pop) %>%
  select(race_ethnicity, infections) %>%
  left_join(get_death_num) %>%
  mutate(IFR = deaths/infections) %>%
  left_join(pop_structure_ca) %>%
  select(IFR, race_ethnicity, age_cutoff,age_perc) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = age_cutoff, values_from = age_perc) %>%
  mutate(ifr_under65 = IFR/(`under 65` + (1/0.046)*`over 65`),
         ifr_over65 = (1/0.046)*ifr_under65
         )

white_under_65 <- IFR_serology_ca %>% filter(race_ethnicity == "white") %>% select(ifr_under65)
white_under_65 <- white_under_65$ifr_under65[1]
white_over_65 <- IFR_serology_ca %>% filter(race_ethnicity == "white") %>% select(ifr_over65)
white_over_65 <- white_over_65$ifr_over65[1]

IFR_serology_ca <- IFR_serology_ca %>%
  mutate(index_under = white_under_65, index_over = white_over_65) %>%
  group_by(race_ethnicity) %>%
  mutate(new_under = min(ifr_under65, white_under_65),
         new_over = min(ifr_over65, white_over_65),
         new_IFR = `under 65`*new_under + `over 65`*new_over
         )
```

```{r}
  filter(day == 119)

## R is calculated off of calibration_NC and the cumulative number of reported cases up to 119
```

### Run
```{r}
dt_run <- read_csv("../data/out_data/param_estimate_NC_phase1_for_phase2.csv")

t_start1 = 119
t_end1 = 285
t_start2 = 285
t_end2 = 329 #363 #315
t_start3 = 329 #363 #315
t_end3 = 455

data = calibration_NC_phase2
data_calib = calibration_NC_phase2
run_parms = NC_parms
run_init = init_NC

paras1 <- run_parms
paras1["rr_asian"] <- dt_run$Estimate[1] * dt_run$Estimate[4]
paras1["rr_black"] <- dt_run$Estimate[2] * dt_run$Estimate[4]
paras1["rr_other"] <- dt_run$Estimate[3] * dt_run$Estimate[4]
paras1["rr_white"] <- dt_run$Estimate[4]

paras1["npi_out_asian"] <- dt_run$Estimate[9] #npi_out_asian_scale*npi_out_white
paras1["npi_out_black"] <- dt_run$Estimate[9] #npi_out_black_scale*npi_out_white
paras1["npi_out_other"] <- dt_run$Estimate[9] #npi_out_other_scale*npi_out_white
paras1["npi_out_white"] <- dt_run$Estimate[9] #npi_out_white


## set to IFRs over the whole period for each group (from seroprevalence data)
paras1["sigma1_asian"] <- 0.002192918
paras1["sigma1_black"] <- 0.008161487
paras1["sigma1_other"] <- 0.001260678
paras1["sigma1_white"] <- 0.007533983

npi_asian = dt_run$Estimate[5]*dt_run$Estimate[8]
npi_black = dt_run$Estimate[6]*dt_run$Estimate[8]
npi_other = dt_run$Estimate[7]*dt_run$Estimate[8]
npi_white = dt_run$Estimate[8]

paras1["npi_asian"] <- npi_asian
paras1["npi_black"] <- npi_black
paras1["npi_other"] <- npi_other
paras1["npi_white"] <- npi_white

init <- run_init

#To build out initial conditions
# Currently infected: the reported cases for the week, minus anyone who has died this week
# Currently dead: all deaths up to this point
# Currently recovered: all cases up to this point, minus active infections (I), and all deaths up to this point
# Susceptible: everyone who is left

## adjust initial infected based on reporting rate - the number infected is the number reported that day divided by reporting rate
## remove deaths from past week
init["I1_asian"] <- init["RepCases_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - 1
init["I1_black"] <- init["RepCases_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - 29
init["I1_other"] <- init["RepCases_other"]/paras1["rr_other"] - 2
init["I1_white"] <- init["RepCases_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - 67

# adjust initial recovered based on reporting rate and deaths ever
init["R1_asian"] <- init["R1_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - init["D_asian"] - init["I1_asian"]
init["R1_black"] <- init["R1_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - init["D_black"] - init["I1_black"]
init["R1_other"] <- init["R1_other"]/paras1["rr_other"] - init["D_other"] - init["I1_other"]
init["R1_white"] <- init["R1_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - init["D_white"] - init["I1_white"]

# create susceptibles
init["S1_asian"] <- Pop_Asian_NC - init["I1_asian"] - init["R1_asian"] - init["D_asian"]
init["S1_black"] <- Pop_Black_NC - init["I1_black"] - init["R1_black"] - init["D_black"]
init["S1_other"] <- Pop_Other_NC - init["I1_other"] - init["R1_other"] - init["D_other"]
init["S1_white"] <- Pop_White_NC - init["I1_white"] - init["R1_white"] - init["D_white"]

## set initial stay at home based on npi1 - just S1, I1, R1

init["S1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["S1_asian"]
init["S1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["S1_asian"]
init["I1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["I1_asian"]
init["I1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["I1_asian"]
init["R1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["R1_asian"]
init["R1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["R1_asian"]

init["S1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["S1_black"]
init["S1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["S1_black"]
init["I1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["I1_black"]
init["I1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["I1_black"]
init["R1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["R1_black"]
init["R1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["R1_black"]

init["S1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["S1_other"]
init["S1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["S1_other"]
init["I1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["I1_other"]
init["I1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["I1_other"]
init["R1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["R1_other"]
init["R1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["R1_other"]

init["S1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["S1_white"]
init["S1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["S1_white"]
init["I1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["I1_white"]
init["I1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["I1_white"]
init["R1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["R1_white"]
init["R1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["R1_white"]

times1 <- seq(t_start1,t_end1, by = 1)
#times2 <- seq(t_start2,t_end2, by = 1)

out_calib1 <- ode(y=init, func = seir2_nolatino_vax, times=times1, parms = paras1, method = "euler") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  as_tibble()

dt_run2 <- read_csv("../data/out_data/param_estimate_NC_phase2_alternate.csv")

paras2 <- paras1
  paras2["rr_asian"] <- dt_run2$Estimate[2]*paras1["rr_asian"]
  paras2["rr_black"] <- dt_run2$Estimate[2]*paras1["rr_black"]
  paras2["rr_other"] <- dt_run2$Estimate[2]*paras1["rr_other"]
  paras2["rr_white"] <- dt_run2$Estimate[2]*paras1["rr_white"]
  paras2["npi_out_asian"] <- dt_run2$Estimate[1]
  paras2["npi_out_black"] <- dt_run2$Estimate[1]
  paras2["npi_out_other"] <-dt_run2$Estimate[1]
  paras2["npi_out_white"] <-dt_run2$Estimate[1]
  
  paras2["npi_secondwave"] <-dt_run2$Estimate[3]
  #paras2["npi_halfway"] <- dt_run2$Estimate[4]
  
  times2 <- seq(t_start2,t_end2, by = 1)
  times3 <- seq(t_start3, t_end3, by = 1)
  
  init2 <- out_calib1 %>% 
    filter(time == max(time, na.rm = T)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-time) %>%
    select(name, value) %>%
    arrange(factor(name, levels = names_var)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "name", values_from = "value") %>%
    unlist() 
  
  out_calib1 <- out_calib1 %>%
    pivot_longer(-time) %>% 
    filter(substr(name, 1,1) == "D" | substr(name, 1,2) == "Re") %>% 
    separate(name, into = c("target", "race_ethnicity")) %>%
    mutate(target = case_when(
      target == "D" ~ "Deaths",
      target == "RepCases" ~ "Cases"
    )) %>% 
    filter(time != t_end1) %>%
    select(day = time, target, race_ethnicity, model_predicted = value) %>% 
    inner_join(data, by = c("target", "race_ethnicity", "day"))
  
  # second run
  out_calib2 <- ode(y=init2, func = seir2_nolatino_vax, times=times2, parms = paras2, method = "euler") %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    as_tibble()
  
  # init for third run 
  init3 <- out_calib2 %>%
    filter(time == max(time, na.rm = T)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-time) %>%
    select(name, value) %>%
    arrange(factor(name, levels = names_var)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "name", values_from = "value") %>%
    unlist()
  
  out_calib2 <- out_calib2 %>%
    pivot_longer(-time) %>% 
    filter(substr(name, 1,1) == "D" | substr(name, 1,2) == "Re") %>% 
    separate(name, into = c("target", "race_ethnicity")) %>%
    mutate(target = case_when(
      target == "D" ~ "Deaths",
      target == "RepCases" ~ "Cases"
    )) %>% 
    filter(time != t_end2) %>%
    select(day = time, target, race_ethnicity, model_predicted = value) %>% 
    inner_join(data, by = c("target", "race_ethnicity", "day"))

  out_calib3 <- ode(y=init3, func = seir2_nolatino_vax2, times=times3, parms = paras2, method = "euler") %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    as_tibble()
  
  out_calib3 <- out_calib3 %>%
    pivot_longer(-time) %>% 
    filter(substr(name, 1,1) == "D" | substr(name, 1,2) == "Re") %>% 
    separate(name, into = c("target", "race_ethnicity")) %>%
    mutate(target = case_when(
      target == "D" ~ "Deaths",
      target == "RepCases" ~ "Cases"
    )) %>% 
    select(day = time, target, race_ethnicity, model_predicted = value) %>% 
    inner_join(data, by = c("target", "race_ethnicity", "day"))
  
  out_calib_full_nc <- rbind(out_calib1, out_calib2) %>% rbind(out_calib3)
  

```

### Seroprevalence 
```{r}

run_start <- as.Date("5-1-2020", "%m-%d-%Y")

sero_data <- read_csv("../data/serology_data_complete.csv") %>%
  filter(location == 37) %>%
  filter(serology_type == "infection") %>%
  select(race_ethnicity, month, year, region, value, median_donation) %>%
  group_by(race_ethnicity, region) %>% ## smooth rolling mean by each region
  arrange(median_donation) %>%
  mutate(smooth_value = rollmean(value, 3, fill = NA)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # group_by(race_ethnicity, median_donation, region) %>%
  # ungroup() %>%
  mutate(median_donation = floor_date(median_donation, "month")) %>% ## Date is floored by month to get a smoothed curve
  mutate(day = difftime(median_donation,run_start-119, "days")) %>% 
  mutate(day = gsub(" days", "", day)) %>%
  mutate(day = as.numeric(day)) %>%
  select(race_ethnicity, day, mean_sero = value, region, smooth_value) %>% 
  group_by(day, race_ethnicity) %>%   # average of rolling means (aggregate regions)
  summarise(smooth_mean_sero = mean(smooth_value)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(race_ethnicity != "overall")

plot_out_sero2 <- out_calib_full_nc %>%
  filter(target == "Cases") %>%
  group_by(race_ethnicity) %>% ## un-cumulative the cases to apply reporting rate
  arrange(day) %>%
  mutate(model_predicted = model_predicted-lag(model_predicted)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    rr_phase1 = case_when(
    race_ethnicity == "asian" ~ paras1["rr_asian"],
    race_ethnicity == "black" ~ paras1["rr_black"],
    race_ethnicity == "other" ~ paras1["rr_other"],
    race_ethnicity == "white" ~ paras1["rr_white"]
    ),
    rr_phase2 = case_when(
    race_ethnicity == "asian" ~ paras2["rr_asian"],
    race_ethnicity == "black" ~ paras2["rr_black"],
    race_ethnicity == "other" ~ paras2["rr_other"],
    race_ethnicity == "white" ~ paras2["rr_white"]
  )) %>%
  mutate(rr = if_else(day >= 285, rr_phase2, rr_phase1)) %>%
    mutate(pop = case_when(
    race_ethnicity == "asian" ~ Pop_Asian_NC,
    race_ethnicity == "black" ~ Pop_Black_NC,
    race_ethnicity == "white" ~ Pop_White_NC,
    race_ethnicity == "other" ~ Pop_Other_NC,
  )) %>%
    mutate(model_predicted = case_when(
    race_ethnicity == "asian" ~ model_predicted,
    race_ethnicity == "black" ~ model_predicted,
    race_ethnicity == "other" ~ model_predicted,
    race_ethnicity == "white" ~ model_predicted
  )) %>%
  mutate(model_predicted = model_predicted/rr,
         model_predicted = model_predicted/pop) %>%
  ## re-cumulative the cases
  group_by(race_ethnicity)  %>%
  arrange(day) %>%
  filter(!is.na(model_predicted)) %>%
  mutate(model_predicted = cumsum(model_predicted)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(day, race_ethnicity, value = model_predicted) %>%
  mutate(type = "Modeled") %>%
  rbind(sero_data %>% select(day, race_ethnicity, value = smooth_mean_sero) %>% mutate(type = "Serological data")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = day + mindate)) +
  ggtitle("Seroprevalence: North Carolina") +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 285), linetype = "dashed") +
   geom_line(aes(y = value, color = race_ethnicity, linetype = type), size = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1)) +
  scale_x_date(limits = c(mindate + 119, mindate + 456)) +
   facet_wrap(~race_ethnicity, scales = "free") + 
   xlab("date") +
  theme_bw() +
   facet_wrap(~race_ethnicity, scales = "free") + 
        theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
        plot.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 13.5, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12.5),
        plot.margin = unit(c(t=0.2, r=0.2, b=0.2, l=0.2), "cm"),
        legend.key.width= unit(1.2, 'cm'),
        legend.position = "right", plot.title.position = "plot",
        legend.title = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
        strip.text.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11, hjust = 0),
        strip.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 10, hjust = 0),
        strip.background = element_rect(colour="white", fill="white"),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA),
        panel.spacing = unit(0.3, "cm"), aspect.ratio=0.8)
```
