### Run
```{r}
save_rep_CA_C <- tibble(NULL)

for (i in 1:rep_num){

run_start <- as.Date("5-1-2020", "%m-%d-%Y")

df_CA2 <- read_csv("../data/fit/target_data_phase2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
  filter(location != 37) %>%
  mutate(calib_start = difftime(run_start, min(date), units = "days")) %>%
  mutate(day = difftime(date, min(date), units = "days")) %>% 
  mutate(day = gsub(" days", "", day), day = as.numeric(day)) %>% 
  mutate(observed = if_else(target == "inc death", value + min_suppressed, value)) %>% 
  group_by(day, target, race_ethnicity, calib_start) %>% 
  summarise(observed = sum(observed, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(target = gsub("inc death", "Deaths", target),
         target = gsub("inc case", "Cases", target)
         ) %>%
  filter(day > 315)

df_compare <- rbind(df_CA, df_CA2)

dt_use <- draw_lhs %>% filter(rep == i) %>% 
  rename(Estimate = value)

t_start1 = 119
t_end1 = 285
t_start2 = 285
t_end2 = 315
t_start3 = 315
t_end3 = 455

data = calibration_CA_phase2
data_calib = calibration_CA_phase2
run_parms = CA_parms
run_init = init_CA

# series of dates with anticipated weighted proportion of new variant
date <- c(as.Date("05-01-2020", "%m-%d-%Y"),
          as.Date("06-01-2020", "%m-%d-%Y"),
          as.Date("10-01-2020", "%m-%d-%Y"),
          as.Date("11-15-2020", "%m-%d-%Y"),
          as.Date("03-15-2021", "%m-%d-%Y"),
          as.Date("04-15-2021", "%m-%d-%Y")
)
var <- c(
  1,
  1,
  1,
  (0.99*1) + (0.01*dt_use$Estimate[16]),
  (0.5*1) + (0.5*dt_use$Estimate[16]),
  (0.44*1) + (0.66*dt_use$Estimate[16])
)

var_frame <- tibble(date, var) %>%
  mutate(day = difftime(date, mindate, "days")) %>%
  mutate(day = gsub(" days", "", day)) %>%
  mutate(day = as.numeric(day)) %>%
  select(day, var) %>% arrange(day)

# make spline function
variant <- splinefun(x = var_frame$day, y = var_frame$var)


##### first parameter set #####
paras1 <- run_parms
# reporting rate
paras1["rr_asian"] <- dt_use$Estimate[1] * dt_use$Estimate[5]
paras1["rr_black"] <- dt_use$Estimate[1] * dt_use$Estimate[5]
paras1["rr_latino"] <- dt_use$Estimate[1] * dt_use$Estimate[5]
paras1["rr_other"] <- dt_use$Estimate[1] * dt_use$Estimate[5]
paras1["rr_white"] <- dt_use$Estimate[5]

paras1["npi_out_asian"] <-dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[10]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
paras1["npi_out_black"] <-dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[11]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
paras1["npi_out_latino"] <-dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[11]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
paras1["npi_out_other"] <-dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[12]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
paras1["npi_out_white"] <- dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[13]

## set to IFRs over the whole period for each group (from seroprevalence data)
paras1["sigma1_asian"] <- 0.013369570
paras1["sigma1_black"] <- 0.014932698
paras1["sigma1_latino"] <- 0.008206442
paras1["sigma1_other"] <- 0.003015897
paras1["sigma1_white"] <- 0.012578309

npi_asian <- dt_use$Estimate[6]*dt_use$Estimate[10]
npi_black <- dt_use$Estimate[7]*dt_use$Estimate[10]
npi_latino <- dt_use$Estimate[8]*dt_use$Estimate[10]
npi_other <- dt_use$Estimate[9]*dt_use$Estimate[10]
npi_white <- dt_use$Estimate[10]

paras1["npi_asian"] <- npi_asian
paras1["npi_black"] <- npi_black
paras1["npi_latino"] <- npi_latino
paras1["npi_other"] <- npi_other
paras1["npi_white"] <- npi_white

init <- run_init

#To build out initial conditions
# Currently infected: the reported cases for the week, minus anyone who has died this week
# Currently dead: all deaths up to this point
# Currently recovered: all cases up to this point, minus active infections (I), and all deaths up to this point
# Susceptible: everyone who is left

## adjust initial infected based on reporting rate - the number infected is the number reported that day divided by reporting rate
## remove deaths from past week
init["I1_asian"] <- init["RepCases_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - 72
init["I1_black"] <- init["RepCases_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - 54
init["I1_latino"] <- init["RepCases_latino"]/paras1["rr_latino"] - 213
init["I1_other"] <- init["RepCases_other"]/paras1["rr_other"] - 2
init["I1_white"] <- init["RepCases_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - 174

# adjust initial recovered based on reporting rate and deaths ever
init["R1_asian"] <- init["R1_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - init["D_asian"] - init["I1_asian"]
init["R1_black"] <- init["R1_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - init["D_black"] - init["I1_black"]
init["R1_latino"] <- init["R1_latino"]/paras1["rr_latino"] - init["D_latino"] - init["I1_latino"]
init["R1_other"] <- init["R1_other"]/paras1["rr_other"] - init["D_other"] - init["I1_other"]
init["R1_white"] <- init["R1_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - init["D_white"] - init["I1_white"]

# create susceptibles
init["S1_asian"] <- Pop_Asian_CA - init["I1_asian"] - init["R1_asian"] - init["D_asian"]
init["S1_black"] <- Pop_Black_CA - init["I1_black"] - init["R1_black"] - init["D_black"]
init["S1_latino"] <- Pop_Latino_CA - init["I1_latino"] - init["R1_latino"] - init["D_latino"]
init["S1_other"] <- Pop_Other_CA - init["I1_other"] - init["R1_other"] - init["D_other"]
init["S1_white"] <- Pop_White_CA - init["I1_white"] - init["R1_white"] - init["D_white"]


## important to do the lockdown calculation first so that the compartment it's scaled off of does not change before rescaling *that* compartment
init["S1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["S1_asian"]
init["S1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["S1_asian"]
init["I1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["I1_asian"]
init["I1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["I1_asian"]
init["R1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["R1_asian"]
init["R1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["R1_asian"]

init["S1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["S1_black"]
init["S1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["S1_black"]
init["I1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["I1_black"]
init["I1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["I1_black"]
init["R1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["R1_black"]
init["R1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["R1_black"]

init["S1_latino_L"] <- npi_latino*init["S1_latino"]
init["S1_latino"] <- (1-npi_latino)*init["S1_latino"]
init["I1_latino_L"] <- npi_latino*init["I1_latino"]
init["I1_latino"] <- (1-npi_latino)*init["I1_latino"]
init["R1_latino_L"] <- npi_latino*init["R1_latino"]
init["R1_latino"] <- (1-npi_latino)*init["R1_latino"]

init["S1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["S1_other"]
init["S1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["S1_other"]
init["I1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["I1_other"]
init["I1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["I1_other"]
init["R1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["R1_other"]
init["R1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["R1_other"]

init["S1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["S1_white"]
init["S1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["S1_white"]
init["I1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["I1_white"]
init["I1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["I1_white"]
init["R1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["R1_white"]
init["R1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["R1_white"]

##### Run sim 1 #####
times1 <- seq(t_start1,t_end1, by = 1)

out_calib1 <- ode(y=init, func = seir2_vax, times=times1, parms = paras1, method = "euler") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  as_tibble() 

  paras2 <- paras1
  
  paras2["rr_asian"] <- dt_use$Estimate[13]*paras1["rr_asian"]
  paras2["rr_black"] <- dt_use$Estimate[13]*paras1["rr_black"]
  paras2["rr_latino"] <- dt_use$Estimate[13]*paras1["rr_latino"]
  paras2["rr_other"] <- dt_use$Estimate[13]*paras1["rr_other"]
  paras2["rr_white"] <- dt_use$Estimate[13]*paras1["rr_white"]
  paras2["npi_out_asian"] <- dt_use$Estimate[12]
  paras2["npi_out_black"] <- dt_use$Estimate[12]
  paras2["npi_out_latino"] <- dt_use$Estimate[12]
  paras2["npi_out_other"] <- dt_use$Estimate[12]
  paras2["npi_out_white"] <- dt_use$Estimate[12]
  
  paras2["npi_secondwave"] <- dt_use$Estimate[14]
  paras2["npi_halfway"] <- dt_use$Estimate[15]
  
  times2 <- seq(t_start2,t_end2, by = 1)
  times3 <- seq(t_start3,t_end3, by = 1)
  
  # init for second run 
  init2 <- out_calib1 %>% 
    filter(time == max(time, na.rm = T)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-time) %>%
    select(name, value) %>%
    arrange(factor(name, levels = names_var)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "name", values_from = "value") %>%
    unlist() 
  
  out_calib1 <- out_calib1 %>%
    pivot_longer(-time) %>% 
    filter(substr(name, 1,1) == "D" | substr(name, 1,2) == "Re") %>% 
    separate(name, into = c("target", "race_ethnicity")) %>%
    mutate(target = case_when(
      target == "D" ~ "Deaths",
      target == "RepCases" ~ "Cases"
    )) %>% 
    filter(time != t_end1) %>%
    select(day = time, target, race_ethnicity, model_predicted = value) %>% 
    inner_join(data, by = c("target", "race_ethnicity", "day")) 
  
  # second run 
  out_calib2 <- ode(y=init2, func = seir2_vax, times=times2, parms = paras2, method = "euler") %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    as_tibble()
  
  paras2["sigma1_asian"] <- 0.010590283
  paras2["sigma1_black"] <- 0.008852714
  paras2["sigma1_latino"] <- 0.006325710
  paras2["sigma1_other"] <- 0.003015897
  paras2["sigma1_white"] <- 0.012578309
  
  # init for third run 
  init3 <- out_calib2 %>%
    filter(time == max(time, na.rm = T)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-time) %>%
    select(name, value) %>%
    arrange(factor(name, levels = names_var)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "name", values_from = "value") %>%
    unlist()
  
  out_calib2 <- out_calib2 %>%
    pivot_longer(-time) %>% 
    filter(substr(name, 1,1) == "D" | substr(name, 1,2) == "Re") %>% 
    separate(name, into = c("target", "race_ethnicity")) %>%
    mutate(target = case_when(
      target == "D" ~ "Deaths",
      target == "RepCases" ~ "Cases"
    )) %>% 
    filter(time != t_end2) %>%
    select(day = time, target, race_ethnicity, model_predicted = value) %>% 
    inner_join(data, by = c("target", "race_ethnicity", "day")) 
  
  out_calib3 <- ode(y=init3, func = seir2_vax2, times=times3, parms = paras2, method = "euler") %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    as_tibble()
  
  out_calib3 <- out_calib3 %>%
    pivot_longer(-time) %>% 
    filter(substr(name, 1,1) == "D" | substr(name, 1,2) == "Re") %>% 
    separate(name, into = c("target", "race_ethnicity")) %>%
    mutate(target = case_when(
      target == "D" ~ "Deaths",
      target == "RepCases" ~ "Cases"
    )) %>% 
    select(day = time, target, race_ethnicity, model_predicted = value) %>% 
    inner_join(data, by = c("target", "race_ethnicity", "day")) 
  
  out_calib_full_ca <- rbind(out_calib1, out_calib2) %>% rbind(out_calib3) %>% mutate(rep = i)

  save_rep_CA_C <- save_rep_CA_C %>% rbind(out_calib_full_ca)

}
```

### Run 
```{r}
save_rep_CA_D <- tibble(NULL)

for (i in 1:rep_num){

run_start <- as.Date("5-1-2020", "%m-%d-%Y")

df_CA2 <- read_csv("../data/fit/target_data_phase2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
  filter(location != 37) %>%
  mutate(calib_start = difftime(run_start, min(date), units = "days")) %>%
  mutate(day = difftime(date, min(date), units = "days")) %>% 
  mutate(day = gsub(" days", "", day), day = as.numeric(day)) %>% 
  mutate(observed = if_else(target == "inc death", value + min_suppressed, value)) %>% 
  group_by(day, target, race_ethnicity, calib_start) %>% 
  summarise(observed = sum(observed, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(target = gsub("inc death", "Deaths", target),
         target = gsub("inc case", "Cases", target)
         ) %>%
  filter(day > 315)

df_compare <- rbind(df_CA, df_CA2)

dt_use <- draw_lhs %>% filter(rep == i) %>% 
  rename(Estimate = value)

t_start1 = 119
t_end1 = 285
t_start2 = 285
t_end2 = 315
t_start3 = 315
t_end3 = 455

data = calibration_CA_phase2
data_calib = calibration_CA_phase2
run_parms = CA_parms
run_init = init_CA

# series of dates with anticipated weighted proportion of new variant
date <- c(as.Date("05-01-2020", "%m-%d-%Y"),
          as.Date("06-01-2020", "%m-%d-%Y"),
          as.Date("10-01-2020", "%m-%d-%Y"),
          as.Date("11-15-2020", "%m-%d-%Y"),
          as.Date("03-15-2021", "%m-%d-%Y"),
          as.Date("04-15-2021", "%m-%d-%Y")
)
var <- c(
  1,
  1,
  1,
  (0.99*1) + (0.01*dt_use$Estimate[16]),
  (0.5*1) + (0.5*dt_use$Estimate[16]),
  (0.44*1) + (0.66*dt_use$Estimate[16])
)

var_frame <- tibble(date, var) %>%
  mutate(day = difftime(date, mindate, "days")) %>%
  mutate(day = gsub(" days", "", day)) %>%
  mutate(day = as.numeric(day)) %>%
  select(day, var) %>% arrange(day)

# make spline function
variant <- splinefun(x = var_frame$day, y = var_frame$var)


## Reset contacts to step fxn for phase 2
aca <- contact(df_contact_ca2, "asian", "asian")
acb <- contact(df_contact_ca2, "asian", "black")
acl <- contact(df_contact_ca2, "asian", "latino")
aco <- contact(df_contact_ca2, "asian", "other")
acw <- contact(df_contact_ca2, "asian", "white")

bca <- contact(df_contact_ca2, "black", "asian")
bcb <- contact(df_contact_ca2, "black", "black")
bcl <- contact(df_contact_ca2, "black", "latino")
bco <- contact(df_contact_ca2, "black", "other")
bcw <- contact(df_contact_ca2, "black", "white")

lca <- contact(df_contact_ca2, "latino", "asian")
lcb <- contact(df_contact_ca2, "latino", "black")
lcl <- contact(df_contact_ca2, "latino", "latino")
lco <- contact(df_contact_ca2, "latino", "other")
lcw <- contact(df_contact_ca2, "latino", "white")

oca <- contact(df_contact_ca2, "other", "asian")
ocb <- contact(df_contact_ca2, "other", "black")
ocl <- contact(df_contact_ca2, "other", "latino")
oco <- contact(df_contact_ca2, "other", "other")
ocw <- contact(df_contact_ca2, "other", "white")

wca <- contact(df_contact_ca2, "white", "asian")
wcb <- contact(df_contact_ca2, "white", "black")
wcl <- contact(df_contact_ca2, "white", "latino")
wco <- contact(df_contact_ca2, "white", "other")
wcw <- contact(df_contact_ca2, "white", "white")

##### first parameter set #####
paras1 <- run_parms
# reporting rate
paras1["rr_asian"] <- dt_use$Estimate[1] * dt_use$Estimate[5]
paras1["rr_black"] <- dt_use$Estimate[1] * dt_use$Estimate[5]
paras1["rr_latino"] <- dt_use$Estimate[1] * dt_use$Estimate[5]
paras1["rr_other"] <- dt_use$Estimate[1] * dt_use$Estimate[5]
paras1["rr_white"] <- dt_use$Estimate[5]

paras1["npi_out_asian"] <-dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[10]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
paras1["npi_out_black"] <-dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[11]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
paras1["npi_out_latino"] <-dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[11]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
paras1["npi_out_other"] <-dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[12]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
paras1["npi_out_white"] <- dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[13]

## set to IFRs over the whole period for each group (from seroprevalence data)
paras1["sigma1_asian"] <- 0.013369570
paras1["sigma1_black"] <- 0.014932698
paras1["sigma1_latino"] <- 0.008206442
paras1["sigma1_other"] <- 0.003015897
paras1["sigma1_white"] <- 0.012578309

npi_asian <- dt_use$Estimate[6]*dt_use$Estimate[10]
npi_black <- dt_use$Estimate[7]*dt_use$Estimate[10]
npi_latino <- dt_use$Estimate[8]*dt_use$Estimate[10]
npi_other <- dt_use$Estimate[9]*dt_use$Estimate[10]
npi_white <- dt_use$Estimate[10]

paras1["npi_asian"] <- npi_asian
paras1["npi_black"] <- npi_black
paras1["npi_latino"] <- npi_latino
paras1["npi_other"] <- npi_other
paras1["npi_white"] <- npi_white

init <- run_init

#To build out initial conditions
# Currently infected: the reported cases for the week, minus anyone who has died this week
# Currently dead: all deaths up to this point
# Currently recovered: all cases up to this point, minus active infections (I), and all deaths up to this point
# Susceptible: everyone who is left

## adjust initial infected based on reporting rate - the number infected is the number reported that day divided by reporting rate
## remove deaths from past week
init["I1_asian"] <- init["RepCases_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - 72
init["I1_black"] <- init["RepCases_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - 54
init["I1_latino"] <- init["RepCases_latino"]/paras1["rr_latino"] - 213
init["I1_other"] <- init["RepCases_other"]/paras1["rr_other"] - 2
init["I1_white"] <- init["RepCases_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - 174

# adjust initial recovered based on reporting rate and deaths ever
init["R1_asian"] <- init["R1_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - init["D_asian"] - init["I1_asian"]
init["R1_black"] <- init["R1_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - init["D_black"] - init["I1_black"]
init["R1_latino"] <- init["R1_latino"]/paras1["rr_latino"] - init["D_latino"] - init["I1_latino"]
init["R1_other"] <- init["R1_other"]/paras1["rr_other"] - init["D_other"] - init["I1_other"]
init["R1_white"] <- init["R1_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - init["D_white"] - init["I1_white"]

# create susceptibles
init["S1_asian"] <- Pop_Asian_CA - init["I1_asian"] - init["R1_asian"] - init["D_asian"]
init["S1_black"] <- Pop_Black_CA - init["I1_black"] - init["R1_black"] - init["D_black"]
init["S1_latino"] <- Pop_Latino_CA - init["I1_latino"] - init["R1_latino"] - init["D_latino"]
init["S1_other"] <- Pop_Other_CA - init["I1_other"] - init["R1_other"] - init["D_other"]
init["S1_white"] <- Pop_White_CA - init["I1_white"] - init["R1_white"] - init["D_white"]


## important to do the lockdown calculation first so that the compartment it's scaled off of does not change before rescaling *that* compartment
init["S1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["S1_asian"]
init["S1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["S1_asian"]
init["I1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["I1_asian"]
init["I1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["I1_asian"]
init["R1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["R1_asian"]
init["R1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["R1_asian"]

init["S1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["S1_black"]
init["S1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["S1_black"]
init["I1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["I1_black"]
init["I1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["I1_black"]
init["R1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["R1_black"]
init["R1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["R1_black"]

init["S1_latino_L"] <- npi_latino*init["S1_latino"]
init["S1_latino"] <- (1-npi_latino)*init["S1_latino"]
init["I1_latino_L"] <- npi_latino*init["I1_latino"]
init["I1_latino"] <- (1-npi_latino)*init["I1_latino"]
init["R1_latino_L"] <- npi_latino*init["R1_latino"]
init["R1_latino"] <- (1-npi_latino)*init["R1_latino"]

init["S1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["S1_other"]
init["S1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["S1_other"]
init["I1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["I1_other"]
init["I1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["I1_other"]
init["R1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["R1_other"]
init["R1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["R1_other"]

init["S1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["S1_white"]
init["S1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["S1_white"]
init["I1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["I1_white"]
init["I1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["I1_white"]
init["R1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["R1_white"]
init["R1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["R1_white"]

##### Run sim 1 #####
times1 <- seq(t_start1,t_end1, by = 1)

out_calib1 <- ode(y=init, func = seir2_vax, times=times1, parms = paras1, method = "euler") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  as_tibble() 

  paras2 <- paras1
  
  paras2["rr_asian"] <- dt_use$Estimate[13]*paras1["rr_asian"]
  paras2["rr_black"] <- dt_use$Estimate[13]*paras1["rr_black"]
  paras2["rr_latino"] <- dt_use$Estimate[13]*paras1["rr_latino"]
  paras2["rr_other"] <- dt_use$Estimate[13]*paras1["rr_other"]
  paras2["rr_white"] <- dt_use$Estimate[13]*paras1["rr_white"]
  paras2["npi_out_asian"] <- dt_use$Estimate[12]
  paras2["npi_out_black"] <- dt_use$Estimate[12]
  paras2["npi_out_latino"] <- dt_use$Estimate[12]
  paras2["npi_out_other"] <- dt_use$Estimate[12]
  paras2["npi_out_white"] <- dt_use$Estimate[12]
  
  paras2["npi_secondwave"] <- dt_use$Estimate[14]
  paras2["npi_halfway"] <- dt_use$Estimate[15]
  
  times2 <- seq(t_start2,t_end2, by = 1)
  times3 <- seq(t_start3,t_end3, by = 1)
  
  # init for second run 
  init2 <- out_calib1 %>% 
    filter(time == max(time, na.rm = T)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-time) %>%
    select(name, value) %>%
    arrange(factor(name, levels = names_var)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "name", values_from = "value") %>%
    unlist() 
  
  out_calib1 <- out_calib1 %>%
    pivot_longer(-time) %>% 
    filter(substr(name, 1,1) == "D" | substr(name, 1,2) == "Re") %>% 
    separate(name, into = c("target", "race_ethnicity")) %>%
    mutate(target = case_when(
      target == "D" ~ "Deaths",
      target == "RepCases" ~ "Cases"
    )) %>% 
    filter(time != t_end1) %>%
    select(day = time, target, race_ethnicity, model_predicted = value) %>% 
    inner_join(data, by = c("target", "race_ethnicity", "day")) 
  
  # second run 
  out_calib2 <- ode(y=init2, func = seir2_vax, times=times2, parms = paras2, method = "euler") %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    as_tibble()
  
    ## Reset contacts to step fxn for phase 2
aca <- contact(df_contact_ca2_counter, "asian", "asian")
acb <- contact(df_contact_ca2_counter, "asian", "black")
acl <- contact(df_contact_ca2_counter, "asian", "latino")

bca <- contact(df_contact_ca2_counter, "black", "asian")
bcb <- contact(df_contact_ca2_counter, "black", "black")
bcl <- contact(df_contact_ca2_counter, "black", "latino")
bco <- contact(df_contact_ca2_counter, "black", "other")
bcw <- contact(df_contact_ca2_counter, "black", "white")

lca <- contact(df_contact_ca2_counter, "latino", "asian")
lcb <- contact(df_contact_ca2_counter, "latino", "black")
lcl <- contact(df_contact_ca2_counter, "latino", "latino")
lco <- contact(df_contact_ca2_counter, "latino", "other")
lcw <- contact(df_contact_ca2_counter, "latino", "white")

oca <- contact(df_contact_ca2_counter, "other", "asian")
ocb <- contact(df_contact_ca2_counter, "other", "black")

paras2["npi_asian"] <- npi_asian
paras2["npi_black"] <- npi_black
paras2["npi_latino"] <- npi_latino

  paras2["sigma1_asian"] <- 0.010590283

  paras2["sigma1_latino"] <- 0.006325710
  paras2["sigma1_other"] <- 0.003015897
  paras2["sigma1_white"] <- 0.012578309
  
  # init for third run 
  init3 <- out_calib2 %>%
    filter(time == max(time, na.rm = T)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-time) %>%

    unlist()
  
  out_calib2 <- out_calib2 %>%

  out_calib3 <- ode(y=init3, func = seir2_vax2, times=times3, parms = paras2, method = "euler") %>%
```

# Prepare Submission Phase 2
## NC A
### Initial conditions 
```{r}
source("SMH_fitting_setup_NC.R")

## Replace contact functions for phase 2 fitting 
aca <- contact(df_contact_nc2, "asian", "asian")
acb <- contact(df_contact_nc2, "asian", "black")
aco <- contact(df_contact_nc2, "asian", "other")
acw <- contact(df_contact_nc2, "asian", "white")

bca <- contact(df_contact_nc2, "black", "asian")
bcb <- contact(df_contact_nc2, "black", "black")
bco <- contact(df_contact_nc2, "black", "other")
bcw <- contact(df_contact_nc2, "black", "white")

oca <- contact(df_contact_nc2, "other", "asian")
ocb <- contact(df_contact_nc2, "other", "black")
oco <- contact(df_contact_nc2, "other", "other")
ocw <- contact(df_contact_nc2, "other", "white")

wca <- contact(df_contact_nc2, "white", "asian")
wcb <- contact(df_contact_nc2, "white", "black")
wco <- contact(df_contact_nc2, "white", "other")
wcw <- contact(df_contact_nc2, "white", "white")

init_NC <- rep(0,length(names_var_nolatino))
names(init_NC) <- names_var_nolatino
initial_I_NC <- df_NC %>%
  filter(day == 119)
initial_DR_NC <- cum_init_NC %>%
  filter(day == 119)
## RepCases and D are based on the reported infections/deaths on day 119, since both observed and model data are counted cumulatively from day 119. 
## R is calculated off of calibration_NC and the cumulative number of reported cases up to 119
init_NC["RepCases_asian"] <- 106
init_NC["D_asian"] <- 3
init_NC["R1_asian"] <- 285

init_NC["RepCases_black"] <- 559
init_NC["D_black"] <- 143
init_NC["R1_black"] <- 3570

init_NC["RepCases_other"] <- 428
init_NC["D_other"] <- 9
init_NC["R1_other"] <- 1346

init_NC["RepCases_white"] <- 1109
init_NC["D_white"] <- 270
init_NC["R1_white"] <- 5445
```

### Make latin hypercube sample
```{r}

param_names <- c("rr_asian_scale", "rr_black_scale", "rr_other_scale", "rr_white",
                 "npi_asian_scale", "npi_black_scale", "npi_other_scale", "npi_white",
                 "npi_out", "npi_out2",
                 "rr_secondwave", "npi_secondwave" #, "npi_halfway"
                 )

dt_profiles <- read_csv("../data/profile_NC_2/ rr_asian_scale ph1.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_NC_2/ rr_black_scale ph1.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>% 
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_NC_2/ rr_other_scale ph1.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>% 
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_NC_2/ rr_white ph1.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>% 
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_NC_2/ npi_asian_scale ph1.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>% 
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_NC_2/ npi_black_scale ph1.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>% 
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_NC_2/ npi_other_scale ph1.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>% 
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_NC_2/ npi_white ph1.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>% 
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_NC_2/ npi_out ph1.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>% 
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_NC_2/ npi_out2 ph2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>% 
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_NC_2/ rr_secondwave ph2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>% 
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_NC_2/ npi_secondwave ph2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>% 
  mutate(conf_05 = if_else(
    ll_05 == -10^3, round(conf_05, 2), conf_05
  ),
  conf_95 = if_else(
    ll_95 == -10^3, round(conf_95, 2), conf_95
  )) %>%
  select(name = param, lower = conf_05, upper = conf_95) %>%
  rbind(c(name = "npi_halfway", lower = 0, upper = 20)) %>%
  rbind(c(name = "v_inc", lower = 1.4, upper = 1.6)) %>%
  mutate(lower = as.numeric(lower), upper = as.numeric(upper)) %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  mutate(lower = max(lower, 0)) %>%
  ungroup()

rep_num <- 200

draw_lhs <- randomLHS(rep_num, 14) %>%
  as.data.frame()
  ## each is scaled 0-1, need to rescale based on st dev
colnames(draw_lhs) <- c(param_names,"npi_halfway", "v_inc") 
draw_lhs <- draw_lhs %>% 
  mutate(rep = 1:rep_num) %>%
  pivot_longer(-rep) %>% 
  left_join(dt_profiles) %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
    mutate(lower = max(0, lower),
         upper = max(0,upper)
         ) %>%
  mutate(value2 = rescale(value, to = c(min(lower), max(upper)))) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  select(rep, name, value = value2)


```

### Run 
```{r, warning=FALSE}
save_rep_NC_A <- tibble(NULL)

for (i in 1:rep_num){

run_start <- as.Date("5-1-2020", "%m-%d-%Y")

df_NC2 <- read_csv("../data/fit/target_data_phase2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
  filter(location == 37) %>%
  mutate(calib_start = difftime(run_start, min(date), units = "days")) %>%
  mutate(day = difftime(date, min(date), units = "days")) %>% 
  mutate(day = gsub(" days", "", day), day = as.numeric(day)) %>% 
  mutate(observed = if_else(target == "inc death", value + min_suppressed, value)) %>% 
  group_by(day, target, race_ethnicity, calib_start) %>% 
  summarise(observed = sum(observed, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(target = gsub("inc death", "Deaths", target),
         target = gsub("inc case", "Cases", target)
         ) %>%
  filter(day > 315)

df_compare <- rbind(df_NC, df_NC2)

dt_use <- draw_lhs %>% filter(rep == i) %>% 
  rename(Estimate = value)

t_start1 = 119
t_end1 = 285
t_start2 = 285
t_end2 = 315
t_start3 = 315
t_end3 = 455

data = calibration_NC_phase2
data_calib = calibration_NC_phase2
run_parms = NC_parms
run_init = init_NC
# 
# series of dates with anticipated weighted proportion of new variant
date <- c(as.Date("05-01-2020", "%m-%d-%Y"),
          as.Date("06-01-2020", "%m-%d-%Y"),
          as.Date("10-01-2020", "%m-%d-%Y"),
          as.Date("11-15-2020", "%m-%d-%Y"),
          as.Date("03-15-2021", "%m-%d-%Y"),
          as.Date("04-15-2021", "%m-%d-%Y")
)
var <- c(
  1,
  1,
  1,
  (0.99*1) + (0.01*dt_use$Estimate[14]),
  (0.5*1) + (0.5*dt_use$Estimate[14]),
  (0.44*1) + (0.66*dt_use$Estimate[14])
)

var_frame <- tibble(date, var) %>%
  mutate(day = difftime(date, mindate, "days")) %>%
  mutate(day = gsub(" days", "", day)) %>%
  mutate(day = as.numeric(day)) %>%
  select(day, var) %>% arrange(day)

# make spline function
variant <- splinefun(x = var_frame$day, y = var_frame$var)


paras1 <- run_parms
paras1["rr_asian"] <- dt_use$Estimate[1] * dt_use$Estimate[4]
paras1["rr_black"] <- dt_use$Estimate[2] * dt_use$Estimate[4]
paras1["rr_other"] <- dt_use$Estimate[3] * dt_use$Estimate[4]
paras1["rr_white"] <- dt_use$Estimate[4]

paras1["npi_out_asian"] <- dt_use$Estimate[9] #npi_out_asian_scale*npi_out_white
paras1["npi_out_black"] <- dt_use$Estimate[9] #npi_out_black_scale*npi_out_white
paras1["npi_out_other"] <- dt_use$Estimate[9] #npi_out_other_scale*npi_out_white
paras1["npi_out_white"] <- dt_use$Estimate[9] #npi_out_white

## set to IFRs over the whole period for each group (from seroprevalence data)
paras1["sigma1_asian"] <- 0.002192918
paras1["sigma1_black"] <- 0.008161487
paras1["sigma1_other"] <- 0.001260678
paras1["sigma1_white"] <- 0.007533983

## NPI
npi_asian = dt_use$Estimate[5]*dt_use$Estimate[8]
npi_black = dt_use$Estimate[6]*dt_use$Estimate[8]
npi_other = dt_use$Estimate[7]*dt_use$Estimate[8]
npi_white = dt_use$Estimate[8]

paras1["npi_asian"] <- npi_asian
paras1["npi_black"] <- npi_black
paras1["npi_other"] <- npi_other
paras1["npi_white"] <- npi_white

init <- run_init

#To build out initial conditions
# Currently infected: the reported cases for the week, minus anyone who has died this week
# Currently dead: all deaths up to this point
# Currently recovered: all cases up to this point, minus active infections (I), and all deaths up to this point
# Susceptible: everyone who is left

## adjust initial infected based on reporting rate - the number infected is the number reported that day divided by reporting rate
## remove deaths from past week
init["I1_asian"] <- init["RepCases_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - 1
init["I1_black"] <- init["RepCases_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - 29
init["I1_other"] <- init["RepCases_other"]/paras1["rr_other"] - 2
init["I1_white"] <- init["RepCases_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - 67

# adjust initial recovered based on reporting rate and deaths ever
init["R1_asian"] <- init["R1_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - init["D_asian"] - init["I1_asian"]
init["R1_black"] <- init["R1_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - init["D_black"] - init["I1_black"]
init["R1_other"] <- init["R1_other"]/paras1["rr_other"] - init["D_other"] - init["I1_other"]
init["R1_white"] <- init["R1_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - init["D_white"] - init["I1_white"]

# create susceptibles
init["S1_asian"] <- Pop_Asian_NC - init["I1_asian"] - init["R1_asian"] - init["D_asian"]
init["S1_black"] <- Pop_Black_NC - init["I1_black"] - init["R1_black"] - init["D_black"]
init["S1_other"] <- Pop_Other_NC - init["I1_other"] - init["R1_other"] - init["D_other"]
init["S1_white"] <- Pop_White_NC - init["I1_white"] - init["R1_white"] - init["D_white"]

## set initial stay at home based on npi1 - just S1, I1, R1

init["S1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["S1_asian"]
init["S1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["S1_asian"]
init["I1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["I1_asian"]
init["I1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["I1_asian"]
init["R1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["R1_asian"]
init["R1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["R1_asian"]

init["S1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["S1_black"]
init["S1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["S1_black"]
init["I1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["I1_black"]
init["I1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["I1_black"]
init["R1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["R1_black"]
init["R1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["R1_black"]

init["S1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["S1_other"]
init["S1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["S1_other"]
init["I1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["I1_other"]
init["I1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["I1_other"]
init["R1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["R1_other"]
init["R1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["R1_other"]

init["S1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["S1_white"]
init["S1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["S1_white"]
init["I1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["I1_white"]
init["I1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["I1_white"]
init["R1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["R1_white"]
init["R1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["R1_white"]

times1 <- seq(t_start1,t_end1, by = 1)
#times2 <- seq(t_start2,t_end2, by = 1)

out_calib1 <- ode(y=init, func = seir2_nolatino_vax, times=times1, parms = paras1, method = "euler") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  as_tibble()


paras2 <- paras1
  paras2["rr_asian"] <- dt_use$Estimate[11]*paras1["rr_asian"]
  paras2["rr_black"] <- dt_use$Estimate[11]*paras1["rr_black"]
  paras2["rr_other"] <- dt_use$Estimate[11]*paras1["rr_other"]
  paras2["rr_white"] <- dt_use$Estimate[11]*paras1["rr_white"]
  paras2["npi_out_asian"] <- dt_use$Estimate[10]
  paras2["npi_out_black"] <- dt_use$Estimate[10]
  paras2["npi_out_other"] <-dt_use$Estimate[10]
  paras2["npi_out_white"] <-dt_use$Estimate[10]
  
  paras2["npi_secondwave"] <- dt_use$Estimate[12]
  paras2["npi_halfway"] <- dt_use$Estimate[13]
  
  times2 <- seq(t_start2,t_end2, by = 1)
  times3 <- seq(t_start3, t_end3, by = 1)
  
  init2 <- out_calib1 %>% 
    filter(time == max(time, na.rm = T)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-time) %>%
    select(name, value) %>%
    arrange(factor(name, levels = names_var)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "name", values_from = "value") %>%
    unlist() 
  
out_calib1 <- out_calib1 %>%
  pivot_longer(-time) %>% 
  filter(substr(name, 1,1) == "D" | substr(name, 1,2) == "Re" | 
           substr(name, 1, 2) == "In") %>%
           #substr(name, 1,2) == "I1" | substr(name, 1, 2) == "I2") %>% 
  separate(name, into = c("target", "race_ethnicity")) %>%
  mutate(target = case_when(
    target == "D" ~ "inc death",
    target == "RepCases" ~ "inc case",
    target == "Inc" ~ "inc inf"
  )) %>% 
  filter(time != t_start2) %>%
   group_by(time, race_ethnicity, target) %>%
   reframe(value = sum(value, na.rm = T)) %>%
   ungroup() %>%
   #filter(target %in% c("inc death", "inc inf")) %>%
  select(day = time, target, race_ethnicity, model_predicted = value)
  
  # second run
  out_calib2 <- ode(y=init2, func = seir2_nolatino_vax, times=times2, parms = paras2, method = "euler") %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    as_tibble()
  
  # init for third run 
  init3 <- out_calib2 %>%
    filter(time == max(time, na.rm = T)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-time) %>%
    select(name, value) %>%
    arrange(factor(name, levels = names_var)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "name", values_from = "value") %>%
    unlist()
  
  out_calib2 <- out_calib2 %>%
  pivot_longer(-time) %>% 
  filter(substr(name, 1,1) == "D" | substr(name, 1,2) == "Re" | 
           substr(name, 1, 2) == "In") %>%
           #substr(name, 1,2) == "I1" | substr(name, 1, 2) == "I2") %>% 
  separate(name, into = c("target", "race_ethnicity")) %>%
  mutate(target = case_when(
    target == "D" ~ "inc death",
    target == "RepCases" ~ "inc case",
    target == "Inc" ~ "inc inf"
  )) %>% 
  filter(time != t_end2) %>%
   group_by(time, race_ethnicity, target) %>%
   reframe(value = sum(value, na.rm = T)) %>%
   ungroup() %>%
   #filter(target %in% c("inc death", "inc inf")) %>%
  select(day = time, target, race_ethnicity, model_predicted = value)

  out_calib3 <- ode(y=init3, func = seir2_nolatino_vax2, times=times3, parms = paras2, method = "euler") %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    as_tibble()
out_calib3 <- out_calib3 %>%
  pivot_longer(-time) %>% 
  filter(substr(name, 1,1) == "D" | substr(name, 1,2) == "Re" | 
           substr(name, 1, 2) == "In") %>%
           #substr(name, 1,2) == "I1" | substr(name, 1, 2) == "I2") %>% 
  separate(name, into = c("target", "race_ethnicity")) %>%
  mutate(target = case_when(
    target == "D" ~ "inc death",
    target == "RepCases" ~ "inc case",
    target == "Inc" ~ "inc inf"
  )) %>% 
   group_by(time, race_ethnicity, target) %>%
   reframe(value = sum(value, na.rm = T)) %>%
   ungroup() %>%
   #filter(target %in% c("inc death", "inc inf")) %>%
  select(day = time, target, race_ethnicity, model_predicted = value)
  
  out_calib_full_nc <- rbind(out_calib1, out_calib2) %>% rbind(out_calib3) %>% mutate(rep = i)

  save_rep_NC_A <- save_rep_NC_A %>% rbind(out_calib_full_nc)

}

```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
    target == "RepCases" ~ "inc case",
    target == "Inc" ~ "inc inf"
  )) %>% 
   group_by(time, race_ethnicity, target) %>%
   reframe(value = sum(value, na.rm = T)) %>%
   ungroup() %>%
   #filter(target %in% c("inc death", "inc inf")) %>%
  select(day = time, target, race_ethnicity, model_predicted = value)
  
  out_calib_full_nc <- rbind(out_calib1, out_calib2) %>% rbind(out_calib3) %>% mutate(rep = i)

  save_rep_NC_C <- save_rep_NC_C %>% rbind(out_calib_full_nc)

}

```

### Run 
```{r, warning=FALSE}
save_rep_NC_D <- tibble(NULL)

for (i in 1:rep_num){

run_start <- as.Date("5-1-2020", "%m-%d-%Y")

df_NC2 <- read_csv("../data/fit/target_data_phase2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
  filter(location == 37) %>%
  mutate(calib_start = difftime(run_start, min(date), units = "days")) %>%
  mutate(day = difftime(date, min(date), units = "days")) %>% 
  mutate(day = gsub(" days", "", day), day = as.numeric(day)) %>% 
  mutate(observed = if_else(target == "inc death", value + min_suppressed, value)) %>% 
  group_by(day, target, race_ethnicity, calib_start) %>% 
  summarise(observed = sum(observed, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(target = gsub("inc death", "Deaths", target),
         target = gsub("inc case", "Cases", target)
         ) %>%
  filter(day > 315)

df_compare <- rbind(df_NC, df_NC2)

dt_use <- draw_lhs %>% filter(rep == i) %>% 
  rename(Estimate = value)

t_start1 = 119
t_end1 = 285
t_start2 = 285
t_end2 = 315
t_start3 = 315
t_end3 = 455

data = calibration_NC_phase2
data_calib = calibration_NC_phase2
run_parms = NC_parms
run_init = init_NC
# 
# series of dates with anticipated weighted proportion of new variant

          as.Date("06-01-2020", "%m-%d-%Y"),
          as.Date("10-01-2020", "%m-%d-%Y"),
          as.Date("11-15-2020", "%m-%d-%Y"),
          as.Date("03-15-2021", "%m-%d-%Y"),
          as.Date("04-15-2021", "%m-%d-%Y")
)
var <- c(
  1,
  1,
  1,
  (0.99*1) + (0.01*dt_use$Estimate[14]),
  (0.5*1) + (0.5*dt_use$Estimate[14]),
  (0.44*1) + (0.66*dt_use$Estimate[14])
)

var_frame <- tibble(date, var) %>%
  mutate(day = difftime(date, mindate, "days")) %>%
  mutate(day = gsub(" days", "", day)) %>%
  mutate(day = as.numeric(day)) %>%
  select(day, var) %>% arrange(day)

# make spline function
variant <- splinefun(x = var_frame$day, y = var_frame$var)

## Replace contact functions for phase 2 fitting 
aca <- contact(df_contact_nc2, "asian", "asian")
acb <- contact(df_contact_nc2, "asian", "black")
aco <- contact(df_contact_nc2, "asian", "other")
acw <- contact(df_contact_nc2, "asian", "white")

bcb <- contact(df_contact_nc2, "black", "black")
bco <- contact(df_contact_nc2, "black", "other")
bcw <- contact(df_contact_nc2, "black", "white")

oca <- contact(df_contact_nc2, "other", "asian")
ocb <- contact(df_contact_nc2, "other", "black")
oco <- contact(df_contact_nc2, "other", "other")
ocw <- contact(df_contact_nc2, "other", "white")

paras1 <- run_parms
paras1["rr_asian"] <- dt_use$Estimate[1] * dt_use$Estimate[4]
paras1["rr_black"] <- dt_use$Estimate[2] * dt_use$Estimate[4]
paras1["rr_other"] <- dt_use$Estimate[3] * dt_use$Estimate[4]
paras1["rr_white"] <- dt_use$Estimate[4]

paras1["npi_out_asian"] <- dt_use$Estimate[9] #npi_out_asian_scale*npi_out_white
paras1["npi_out_black"] <- dt_use$Estimate[9] #npi_out_black_scale*npi_out_white
paras1["npi_out_other"] <- dt_use$Estimate[9] #npi_out_other_scale*npi_out_white
paras1["npi_out_white"] <- dt_use$Estimate[9] #npi_out_white

## set to IFRs over the whole period for each group (from seroprevalence data)
paras1["sigma1_asian"] <- 0.002192918
paras1["sigma1_black"] <- 0.008161487
paras1["sigma1_other"] <- 0.001260678
paras1["sigma1_white"] <- 0.007533983

## NPI
npi_asian = dt_use$Estimate[5]*dt_use$Estimate[8]
npi_black = dt_use$Estimate[6]*dt_use$Estimate[8]
npi_other = dt_use$Estimate[7]*dt_use$Estimate[8]
npi_white = dt_use$Estimate[8]

paras1["npi_asian"] <- npi_asian
paras1["npi_black"] <- npi_black
paras1["npi_other"] <- npi_other
paras1["npi_white"] <- npi_white

init <- run_init

#To build out initial conditions
# Currently infected: the reported cases for the week, minus anyone who has died this week
# Currently dead: all deaths up to this point
# Currently recovered: all cases up to this point, minus active infections (I), and all deaths up to this point
# Susceptible: everyone who is left

## adjust initial infected based on reporting rate - the number infected is the number reported that day divided by reporting rate
## remove deaths from past week
init["I1_asian"] <- init["RepCases_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - 1
init["I1_black"] <- init["RepCases_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - 29
init["I1_other"] <- init["RepCases_other"]/paras1["rr_other"] - 2
init["I1_white"] <- init["RepCases_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - 67

# adjust initial recovered based on reporting rate and deaths ever
init["R1_asian"] <- init["R1_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - init["D_asian"] - init["I1_asian"]
init["R1_black"] <- init["R1_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - init["D_black"] - init["I1_black"]
init["R1_other"] <- init["R1_other"]/paras1["rr_other"] - init["D_other"] - init["I1_other"]
init["R1_white"] <- init["R1_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - init["D_white"] - init["I1_white"]

# create susceptibles
init["S1_asian"] <- Pop_Asian_NC - init["I1_asian"] - init["R1_asian"] - init["D_asian"]
init["S1_black"] <- Pop_Black_NC - init["I1_black"] - init["R1_black"] - init["D_black"]
init["S1_other"] <- Pop_Other_NC - init["I1_other"] - init["R1_other"] - init["D_other"]
init["S1_white"] <- Pop_White_NC - init["I1_white"] - init["R1_white"] - init["D_white"]

## set initial stay at home based on npi1 - just S1, I1, R1

init["S1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["S1_asian"]
init["S1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["S1_asian"]
init["I1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["I1_asian"]
init["I1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["I1_asian"]
init["R1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["R1_asian"]
init["R1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["R1_asian"]

init["S1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["S1_black"]
init["S1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["S1_black"]
init["I1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["I1_black"]
init["I1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["I1_black"]
init["R1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["R1_black"]
init["R1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["R1_black"]

init["S1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["S1_other"]
init["S1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["S1_other"]
init["I1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["I1_other"]
init["I1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["I1_other"]
init["R1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["R1_other"]
init["R1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["R1_other"]

init["S1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["S1_white"]
init["S1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["S1_white"]
init["I1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["I1_white"]
init["I1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["I1_white"]
init["R1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["R1_white"]
init["R1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["R1_white"]

times1 <- seq(t_start1,t_end1, by = 1)
#times2 <- seq(t_start2,t_end2, by = 1)

paras2 <- paras1
```

### Make latin hypercube sample
```{r}

param_names <- c("rr_asian_scale", "rr_black_scale","rr_latino_scale", "rr_other_scale", "rr_white",
                 "npi_asian_scale", "npi_black_scale","npi_latino_scale", "npi_other_scale", "npi_white",
                 "npi_out", "npi_out2",
                 "rr_secondwave", "npi_secondwave"
                 )

dt_profiles <- read_csv("../data/profile_CA_2/ rr_asian_scale ph1.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_CA_2/ rr_black_scale ph1.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>% 
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_CA_2/ rr_latino_scale ph1.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>% 
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_CA_2/ rr_other_scale ph1.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>% 
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_CA_2/ rr_white ph1.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>% 
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_CA_2/ npi_asian_scale ph1.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>% 
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_CA_2/ npi_black_scale ph1.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>% 
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_CA_2/ npi_latino_scale ph1.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>% 
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_CA_2/ npi_other_scale ph1.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>% 
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_CA_2/ npi_white ph1.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>% 
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_CA_2/ npi_out ph1.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>% 
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_CA_2/ npi_out2 ph2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>% 
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_CA_2/ rr_secondwave ph2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>% 
  rbind(read_csv("../data/profile_CA_2/ npi_secondwave ph2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)) %>% 
  mutate(conf_05 = if_else(
    ll_05 == -10^3, round(conf_05, 2), conf_05
  ),
  conf_95 = if_else(
    ll_95 == -10^3, round(conf_95, 2), conf_95
  )) %>%
  select(name = param, lower = conf_05, upper = conf_95) %>%
  rbind(c(name = "npi_halfway", lower = 0, upper = 20)) %>%
  rbind(c(name = "v_inc", lower = 1.4, upper = 1.6)) %>%
  mutate(lower = as.numeric(lower), upper = as.numeric(upper)) %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  mutate(lower = max(lower, 0)) %>%
  ungroup()

rep_num <- 200

draw_lhs <- randomLHS(rep_num, 16) %>%
  as.data.frame()
  ## each is scaled 0-1, need to rescale based on st dev
colnames(draw_lhs) <- c(param_names, "npi_halfway","v_inc") 
draw_lhs <- draw_lhs %>% 
  mutate(rep = 1:rep_num) %>%
  pivot_longer(-rep) %>% 
  left_join(dt_profiles) %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
    mutate(lower = max(0, lower),
         upper = max(0,upper)
         ) %>%
  mutate(value2 = rescale(value, to = c(min(lower), max(upper)))) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  select(rep, name, value = value2)
```

```{r}
  mutate(day = gsub(" days", "", day), day = as.numeric(day)) %>%

  group_by(day, target, race_ethnicity, calib_start) %>% 
  summarise(observed = sum(observed, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(target = gsub("inc death", "Deaths", target),
         target = gsub("inc case", "Cases", target)
         ) %>%
  filter(day > 315)

  rename(Estimate = value)

t_start1 = 119
t_end1 = 285
t_start2 = 285
t_end2 = 315
t_start3 = 315

data = calibration_CA_phase2

run_parms = CA_parms
run_init = init_CA

# series of dates with anticipated weighted proportion of new variant
date <- c(as.Date("05-01-2020", "%m-%d-%Y"),
          as.Date("06-01-2020", "%m-%d-%Y"),
          as.Date("10-01-2020", "%m-%d-%Y"),
          as.Date("11-15-2020", "%m-%d-%Y"),
          as.Date("03-15-2021", "%m-%d-%Y"),
          as.Date("04-15-2021", "%m-%d-%Y")
)
var <- c(
  1,
  1,
  1,
  (0.99*1) + (0.01*dt_use$Estimate[16]),
  (0.5*1) + (0.5*dt_use$Estimate[16]),
  (0.44*1) + (0.66*dt_use$Estimate[16])
)

var_frame <- tibble(date, var) %>%
  mutate(day = difftime(date, mindate, "days")) %>%
  mutate(day = gsub(" days", "", day)) %>%
  mutate(day = as.numeric(day)) %>%
  select(day, var) %>% arrange(day)

# make spline function
variant <- splinefun(x = var_frame$day, y = var_frame$var)


##### first parameter set #####
paras1 <- run_parms
# reporting rate
paras1["rr_asian"] <- dt_use$Estimate[1] * dt_use$Estimate[5]
paras1["rr_black"] <- dt_use$Estimate[1] * dt_use$Estimate[5]
paras1["rr_latino"] <- dt_use$Estimate[1] * dt_use$Estimate[5]
paras1["rr_other"] <- dt_use$Estimate[1] * dt_use$Estimate[5]
paras1["rr_white"] <- dt_use$Estimate[5]

paras1["npi_out_asian"] <-dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[10]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
paras1["npi_out_black"] <-dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[11]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
paras1["npi_out_latino"] <-dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[11]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
paras1["npi_out_other"] <-dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[12]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
paras1["npi_out_white"] <- dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[13]

## set to IFRs over the whole period for each group (from seroprevalence data)
paras1["sigma1_asian"] <- 0.013369570
paras1["sigma1_black"] <- 0.014932698
paras1["sigma1_latino"] <- 0.008206442
paras1["sigma1_other"] <- 0.003015897
paras1["sigma1_white"] <- 0.012578309

npi_asian <- dt_use$Estimate[6]*dt_use$Estimate[10]
npi_black <- dt_use$Estimate[7]*dt_use$Estimate[10]
npi_latino <- dt_use$Estimate[8]*dt_use$Estimate[10]
npi_other <- dt_use$Estimate[9]*dt_use$Estimate[10]
npi_white <- dt_use$Estimate[10]

paras1["npi_asian"] <- npi_asian
paras1["npi_black"] <- npi_black
paras1["npi_latino"] <- npi_latino
paras1["npi_other"] <- npi_other
paras1["npi_white"] <- npi_white

init <- run_init

#To build out initial conditions
# Currently infected: the reported cases for the week, minus anyone who has died this week
# Currently dead: all deaths up to this point
# Currently recovered: all cases up to this point, minus active infections (I), and all deaths up to this point
# Susceptible: everyone who is left

## adjust initial infected based on reporting rate - the number infected is the number reported that day divided by reporting rate
## remove deaths from past week
init["I1_asian"] <- init["RepCases_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - 72
init["I1_black"] <- init["RepCases_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - 54
init["I1_latino"] <- init["RepCases_latino"]/paras1["rr_latino"] - 213
init["I1_other"] <- init["RepCases_other"]/paras1["rr_other"] - 2
init["I1_white"] <- init["RepCases_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - 174

# adjust initial recovered based on reporting rate and deaths ever
init["R1_asian"] <- init["R1_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - init["D_asian"] - init["I1_asian"]
init["R1_black"] <- init["R1_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - init["D_black"] - init["I1_black"]
init["R1_latino"] <- init["R1_latino"]/paras1["rr_latino"] - init["D_latino"] - init["I1_latino"]
init["R1_other"] <- init["R1_other"]/paras1["rr_other"] - init["D_other"] - init["I1_other"]
init["R1_white"] <- init["R1_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - init["D_white"] - init["I1_white"]

# create susceptibles
init["S1_asian"] <- Pop_Asian_CA - init["I1_asian"] - init["R1_asian"] - init["D_asian"]
init["S1_black"] <- Pop_Black_CA - init["I1_black"] - init["R1_black"] - init["D_black"]
init["S1_latino"] <- Pop_Latino_CA - init["I1_latino"] - init["R1_latino"] - init["D_latino"]
init["S1_other"] <- Pop_Other_CA - init["I1_other"] - init["R1_other"] - init["D_other"]
init["S1_white"] <- Pop_White_CA - init["I1_white"] - init["R1_white"] - init["D_white"]


## important to do the lockdown calculation first so that the compartment it's scaled off of does not change before rescaling *that* compartment
init["S1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["S1_asian"]
init["S1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["S1_asian"]
init["I1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["I1_asian"]
init["I1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["I1_asian"]
init["R1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["R1_asian"]
init["R1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["R1_asian"]

init["S1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["S1_black"]
init["S1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["S1_black"]
init["I1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["I1_black"]
init["I1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["I1_black"]
init["R1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["R1_black"]
init["R1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["R1_black"]

init["S1_latino_L"] <- npi_latino*init["S1_latino"]
init["S1_latino"] <- (1-npi_latino)*init["S1_latino"]
init["I1_latino_L"] <- npi_latino*init["I1_latino"]
init["I1_latino"] <- (1-npi_latino)*init["I1_latino"]
init["R1_latino_L"] <- npi_latino*init["R1_latino"]
init["R1_latino"] <- (1-npi_latino)*init["R1_latino"]

init["S1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["S1_other"]
init["S1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["S1_other"]
init["I1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["I1_other"]
init["I1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["I1_other"]
init["R1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["R1_other"]
init["R1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["R1_other"]

init["S1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["S1_white"]
init["S1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["S1_white"]
init["I1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["I1_white"]
init["I1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["I1_white"]
init["R1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["R1_white"]
init["R1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["R1_white"]

##### Run sim 1 #####
times1 <- seq(t_start1,t_end1, by = 1)

out_calib1 <- ode(y=init, func = seir2_vax, times=times1, parms = paras1, method = "euler") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  as_tibble() 

  paras2 <- paras1
  paras2["rr_asian"] <- dt_use$Estimate[13]*paras1["rr_asian"]
  paras2["rr_black"] <- dt_use$Estimate[13]*paras1["rr_black"]
  paras2["rr_latino"] <- dt_use$Estimate[13]*paras1["rr_latino"]
  paras2["rr_other"] <- dt_use$Estimate[13]*paras1["rr_other"]
  paras2["rr_white"] <- dt_use$Estimate[13]*paras1["rr_white"]
  paras2["npi_out_asian"] <- dt_use$Estimate[12]
  paras2["npi_out_black"] <- dt_use$Estimate[12]
  paras2["npi_out_latino"] <- dt_use$Estimate[12]
  paras2["npi_out_other"] <- dt_use$Estimate[12]
  paras2["npi_out_white"] <- dt_use$Estimate[12]
  
  paras2["npi_secondwave"] <- dt_use$Estimate[14]
  paras2["npi_halfway"] <- dt_use$Estimate[15]
  
  times2 <- seq(t_start2,t_end2, by = 1)
  times3 <- seq(t_start3,t_end3, by = 1)
  
  # init for second run 
  init2 <- out_calib1 %>% 
    filter(time == max(time, na.rm = T)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-time) %>%
    select(name, value) %>%
    arrange(factor(name, levels = names_var)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "name", values_from = "value") %>%
    unlist() 
  
  out_calib1 <- out_calib1 %>%
  pivot_longer(-time) %>% 
  filter(substr(name, 1,1) == "D" | substr(name, 1,2) == "Re" | 
           substr(name, 1, 2) == "In") %>%
           #substr(name, 1,2) == "I1" | substr(name, 1, 2) == "I2") %>% 
  separate(name, into = c("target", "race_ethnicity")) %>%
  mutate(target = case_when(
    target == "D" ~ "inc death",
    target == "RepCases" ~ "inc case",
    target == "Inc" ~ "inc inf"
  )) %>% 
  filter(time != t_start2) %>%
   group_by(time, race_ethnicity, target) %>%
   reframe(value = sum(value, na.rm = T)) %>%
   ungroup() %>%
   #filter(target %in% c("inc death", "inc inf")) %>%
  select(day = time, target, race_ethnicity, model_predicted = value)
  
  # second run 
  out_calib2 <- ode(y=init2, func = seir2_vax, times=times2, parms = paras2, method = "euler") %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    as_tibble()
  
  # init for third run 
  init3 <- out_calib2 %>%
    filter(time == max(time, na.rm = T)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-time) %>%
    select(name, value) %>%
    arrange(factor(name, levels = names_var)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "name", values_from = "value") %>%
    unlist()
  
  out_calib2 <- out_calib2 %>%
  pivot_longer(-time) %>% 
  filter(substr(name, 1,1) == "D" | substr(name, 1,2) == "Re" | 
           substr(name, 1, 2) == "In") %>%
           #substr(name, 1,2) == "I1" | substr(name, 1, 2) == "I2") %>% 
  separate(name, into = c("target", "race_ethnicity")) %>%
  mutate(target = case_when(
    target == "D" ~ "inc death",
    target == "RepCases" ~ "inc case",
    target == "Inc" ~ "inc inf"
  )) %>% 
  filter(time != t_end2) %>%
   group_by(time, race_ethnicity, target) %>%
   reframe(value = sum(value, na.rm = T)) %>%
   ungroup() %>%
   #filter(target %in% c("inc death", "inc inf")) %>%
  select(day = time, target, race_ethnicity, model_predicted = value)
  
  out_calib3 <- ode(y=init3, func = seir2_vax2, times=times3, parms = paras2, method = "euler") %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    as_tibble()
  
  out_calib3 <- out_calib3 %>%
  pivot_longer(-time) %>% 
  filter(substr(name, 1,1) == "D" | substr(name, 1,2) == "Re" | 
           substr(name, 1, 2) == "In") %>%
           #substr(name, 1,2) == "I1" | substr(name, 1, 2) == "I2") %>% 
  separate(name, into = c("target", "race_ethnicity")) %>%
  mutate(target = case_when(
    target == "D" ~ "inc death",
    target == "RepCases" ~ "inc case",
    target == "Inc" ~ "inc inf"
  )) %>% 
   group_by(time, race_ethnicity, target) %>%
   reframe(value = sum(value, na.rm = T)) %>%
   ungroup() %>%
   #filter(target %in% c("inc death", "inc inf")) %>%
  select(day = time, target, race_ethnicity, model_predicted = value)
  
  out_calib_full_ca <- rbind(out_calib1, out_calib2) %>% rbind(out_calib3) %>% mutate(rep = i)

  save_rep_CA_A <- save_rep_CA_A %>% rbind(out_calib_full_ca)



}
```

```{r}
  mutate(day = gsub(" days", "", day), day = as.numeric(day)) %>% 
  mutate(observed = if_else(target == "inc death", value + min_suppressed, value)) %>% 
  group_by(day, target, race_ethnicity, calib_start) %>% 
  summarise(observed = sum(observed, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(target = gsub("inc death", "Deaths", target),
         target = gsub("inc case", "Cases", target)
         ) %>%

t_end1 = 285

)

)

paras1["npi_out_black"] <-dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[11]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
paras1["npi_out_latino"] <-dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[11]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
paras1["npi_out_other"] <-dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[12]*dt_use$Estimate[13]
paras1["npi_out_white"] <- dt_use$Estimate[11] #dt_use$Estimate[13]

paras1["sigma1_black"] <- 0.014932698
paras1["sigma1_latino"] <- 0.008206442
paras1["sigma1_other"] <- 0.003015897
paras1["sigma1_white"] <- 0.012578309

npi_black <- dt_use$Estimate[7]*dt_use$Estimate[10]
npi_latino <- dt_use$Estimate[8]*dt_use$Estimate[10]

paras1["npi_other"] <- npi_other
paras1["npi_white"] <- npi_white

init <- run_init

#To build out initial conditions
# Currently infected: the reported cases for the week, minus anyone who has died this week
# Currently dead: all deaths up to this point
# Currently recovered: all cases up to this point, minus active infections (I), and all deaths up to this point
# Susceptible: everyone who is left

## adjust initial infected based on reporting rate - the number infected is the number reported that day divided by reporting rate
## remove deaths from past week
init["I1_asian"] <- init["RepCases_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - 72
init["I1_black"] <- init["RepCases_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - 54
init["I1_latino"] <- init["RepCases_latino"]/paras1["rr_latino"] - 213
init["I1_other"] <- init["RepCases_other"]/paras1["rr_other"] - 2
init["I1_white"] <- init["RepCases_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - 174

init["R1_black"] <- init["R1_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - init["D_black"] - init["I1_black"]

init["R1_white"] <- init["R1_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - init["D_white"] - init["I1_white"]

init["R1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["R1_asian"]
```

```{r}
  paras2["sigma1_black"] <- 0.008852714

  paras2["sigma1_other"] <- 0.003015897
  paras2["sigma1_white"] <- 0.012578309
  
  # init for third run 
  init3 <- out_calib2 %>%
    filter(time == max(time, na.rm = T)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-time) %>%
    select(name, value) %>%
    arrange(factor(name, levels = names_var)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "name", values_from = "value") %>%
    unlist()
  
  out_calib2 <- out_calib2 %>%
  pivot_longer(-time) %>% 
  filter(substr(name, 1,1) == "D" | substr(name, 1,2) == "Re" | 
           substr(name, 1, 2) == "In") %>%
           #substr(name, 1,2) == "I1" | substr(name, 1, 2) == "I2") %>% 
  separate(name, into = c("target", "race_ethnicity")) %>%
  mutate(target = case_when(
    target == "D" ~ "inc death",
    target == "RepCases" ~ "inc case",
    target == "Inc" ~ "inc inf"
  )) %>% 
  filter(time != t_end2) %>%
   group_by(time, race_ethnicity, target) %>%
   reframe(value = sum(value, na.rm = T)) %>%
   ungroup() %>%
   #filter(target %in% c("inc death", "inc inf")) %>%
  select(day = time, target, race_ethnicity, model_predicted = value)
  
  out_calib3 <- ode(y=init3, func = seir2_vax2, times=times3, parms = paras2, method = "euler") %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    as_tibble()
  
  out_calib3 <- out_calib3 %>%
  pivot_longer(-time) %>% 
  filter(substr(name, 1,1) == "D" | substr(name, 1,2) == "Re" | 
           substr(name, 1, 2) == "In") %>%
           #substr(name, 1,2) == "I1" | substr(name, 1, 2) == "I2") %>% 
  separate(name, into = c("target", "race_ethnicity")) %>%
  mutate(target = case_when(
    target == "D" ~ "inc death",
    target == "RepCases" ~ "inc case",
    target == "Inc" ~ "inc inf"
  )) %>% 
   group_by(time, race_ethnicity, target) %>%
   reframe(value = sum(value, na.rm = T)) %>%
   ungroup() %>%
   #filter(target %in% c("inc death", "inc inf")) %>%
  select(day = time, target, race_ethnicity, model_predicted = value)
  
  out_calib_full_ca <- rbind(out_calib1, out_calib2) %>% rbind(out_calib3) %>% mutate(rep = i)

  save_rep_CA_C <- save_rep_CA_C %>% rbind(out_calib_full_ca)

}
```

```{r}
#To build out initial conditions
# Currently infected: the reported cases for the week, minus anyone who has died this week
# Currently dead: all deaths up to this point
# Currently recovered: all cases up to this point, minus active infections (I), and all deaths up to this point
# Susceptible: everyone who is left

## adjust initial infected based on reporting rate - the number infected is the number reported that day divided by reporting rate
## remove deaths from past week
init["I1_asian"] <- init["RepCases_asian"]/paras1["rr_asian"] - 72
init["I1_black"] <- init["RepCases_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - 54
init["I1_latino"] <- init["RepCases_latino"]/paras1["rr_latino"] - 213
init["I1_other"] <- init["RepCases_other"]/paras1["rr_other"] - 2
init["I1_white"] <- init["RepCases_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - 174

# adjust initial recovered based on reporting rate and deaths ever

init["R1_black"] <- init["R1_black"]/paras1["rr_black"] - init["D_black"] - init["I1_black"]

init["R1_white"] <- init["R1_white"]/paras1["rr_white"] - init["D_white"] - init["I1_white"]

init["S1_black"] <- Pop_Black_CA - init["I1_black"] - init["R1_black"] - init["D_black"]
init["S1_latino"] <- Pop_Latino_CA - init["I1_latino"] - init["R1_latino"] - init["D_latino"]
init["S1_other"] <- Pop_Other_CA - init["I1_other"] - init["R1_other"] - init["D_other"]
init["S1_white"] <- Pop_White_CA - init["I1_white"] - init["R1_white"] - init["D_white"]


## important to do the lockdown calculation first so that the compartment it's scaled off of does not change before rescaling *that* compartment
init["S1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["S1_asian"]
init["S1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["S1_asian"]
init["I1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["I1_asian"]
init["I1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["I1_asian"]
init["R1_asian_L"] <- npi_asian*init["R1_asian"]
init["R1_asian"] <- (1-npi_asian)*init["R1_asian"]

init["S1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["S1_black"]
init["S1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["S1_black"]

init["I1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["I1_black"]
init["R1_black_L"] <- npi_black*init["R1_black"]
init["R1_black"] <- (1-npi_black)*init["R1_black"]

init["S1_latino"] <- (1-npi_latino)*init["S1_latino"]
init["I1_latino_L"] <- npi_latino*init["I1_latino"]
init["I1_latino"] <- (1-npi_latino)*init["I1_latino"]
init["R1_latino_L"] <- npi_latino*init["R1_latino"]
init["R1_latino"] <- (1-npi_latino)*init["R1_latino"]

init["S1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["S1_other"]
init["S1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["S1_other"]
init["I1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["I1_other"]
init["I1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["I1_other"]
init["R1_other_L"] <- npi_other*init["R1_other"]
init["R1_other"] <- (1-npi_other)*init["R1_other"]

init["S1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["S1_white"]
init["S1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["S1_white"]
init["I1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["I1_white"]
init["I1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["I1_white"]
init["R1_white_L"] <- npi_white*init["R1_white"]
init["R1_white"] <- (1-npi_white)*init["R1_white"]
```

### Final file CA
```{r}
final_run_data_CA_A <- save_rep_CA_A %>%
  group_by(race_ethnicity, target, rep) %>%
  arrange(day) %>%
  mutate(model_predicted = model_predicted - lag(model_predicted)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(day >= 316) %>%
  mutate(date = day + mindate) %>%
  mutate(MMWRweek(date)) %>%
  group_by(MMWRweek, MMWRyear, target, race_ethnicity, rep) %>%
  reframe(value = sum(model_predicted)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(origin_date = MMWRweek2Date(MMWRyear, MMWRweek, MMWRday = NULL)) %>%
  select(origin_date, race_ethnicity, target, value, run_grouping = rep) %>%
  mutate(horizon = difftime(origin_date, min(origin_date), units = "weeks"),
         horizon = gsub(" weeks", "", horizon),
         horizon = as.numeric(horizon) + 1
         ) %>%
  mutate(scenario_id = "A-2020-11-15", 
         location = "06",
         output_type = "sample",
```

## Submission

```{r}
df_submit <- rbind(final_run_data_CA_A, 
                   final_run_data_CA_B) %>%
  rbind(final_run_data_CA_C) %>%
  rbind(final_run_data_CA_D) %>%
  rbind(final_run_data_NC_A) %>%
  rbind(final_run_data_NC_B) %>%
  rbind(final_run_data_NC_C) %>%
  rbind(final_run_data_NC_D) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "race_ethnicity", values_from = "value") %>%
  mutate(overall = 
           if_else(location == "06",
           asian + black + latino + other + white,
           asian + black + other + white
           )
         ) %>%
  pivot_longer(asian:overall, names_to = "race_ethnicity", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  select(origin_date, scenario_id, target, horizon, location, race_ethnicity, output_type, output_type_id, value, run_grouping, stochastic_run) %>%
  mutate(origin_date = as.character(origin_date),
         horizon = as.integer(horizon),
         output_type_id = as.character(output_type_id),
         run_grouping = as.integer(run_grouping),
         stochastic_run = as.integer(stochastic_run)
         )

plot_out <- df_submit %>%
  filter(target == "inc death") %>%
  group_by(race_ethnicity, target,location, horizon) %>%
  summarise(value = mean(value)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = horizon, y = value, color = race_ethnicity)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  facet_grid(location~target, scales = "free")
plot_out

filename <- "~/Desktop/covid19-smh-research/model-output/NIH_UIUC-RIFTcov/2024-07-16-NIH_UIUC-RIFTcov.parquet"
arrow::write_parquet(df_submit, filename)
```
